title: Adjectives with "-ji le"
structure: Subj. + Adj. + 极了
explanation: 用在形容词后表示程度极高，相当于“extremely / super”。必须加“了”。

examples.pinyin: Zhège zhǔyi hǎo jíle.
examples.en: This idea is perfect.

examples.pinyin: Wèidào hǎo jíle!
examples.en: The taste is perfect!

examples.pinyin: Tā de Yīngwén bàng jíle.
examples.en: His English is perfect.

examples.pinyin: Hūnlǐ rènao jíle.
examples.en: The wedding was very lively.

examples.pinyin: Zuótiān de pàiduì wúliáo jíle!
examples.en: Yesterday's party was so boring!

title: Expressing "not very" with "bu zenme"
structure: Subj. + 不怎么 + Adj. / [Psychological Verb]
explanation: “不怎么 + 形容词”表示程度不高，相当于“not very”，语气比直接说“不聪明”更委婉。

examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn bù zěnme máng.
examples.en: It hasn't been very busy lately.

examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de dōngtiān bù zěnme lěng.
examples.en: It's not very cold here in winter.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen hǎoxiàng bù zěnme gāoxìng.
examples.en: They don't seem to be very happy.

examples.pinyin: Zhège xuéshēng bù zěnme nǔlì.
examples.en: This student isn't very hard-working.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zěnme xǐhuan kāfēi.
examples.en: I'm not very into coffee.

title: Indicating the whole with "quan"
structure: 全 + Noun + 都 + Predicate；Subj. + 全都 + Predicate
explanation: “全”表示“整个、全部”，常与“都”搭配。可放在名词前（全家、全公司），也可放在谓语前（全都到了）。

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen quánjiā dōu qù guo Běijīng.
examples.en: Our entire family has been to Beijing.

examples.zh: 全公司的人都不喜欢新老板。
examples.pinyin: Quán gōngsī de rén dōu bù xǐhuan xīn lǎobǎn.
examples.en: The whole company doesn't like the new boss.

examples.zh: 运动完以后我全身都是汗。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng wán yǐhòu wǒ quánshēn dōu shì hàn.
examples.en: My whole body was sweaty after I finished exercising.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā quán dōu dào le.
examples.en: Everybody has arrived.

examples.pinyin: Zuòyè quán dōu zuò wán le ma?
examples.en: Have you finished all your homework?

title: Negative form of 全都：全部否定 vs 部分否定
structure: 全部否定：Subj. + 全都 + 不/没 + Predicate；部分否定：Subj. + 不/没 + 全都 + Predicate
explanation: 否定词在“全都”后 → “none of it / not at all”；否定词在“全都”前 → “not all”。

examples.pinyin: Tāmen quán dōu méi qù.
examples.en: None of them went.

examples.zh: 这个周末我们全都不在家。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒmen quán dōu bù zài jiā.
examples.en: None of us will be home this weekend.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē cài quán dōu méi shú.
examples.en: None of these dishes is fully cooked.

examples.zh: 他说得有道理，但我不全都同意。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de yǒu dàolǐ, dàn wǒ bù quán dōu tóngyì.
examples.en: He has a point, but I don't agree with all of it.

examples.zh: 菜太多了，我们没全都吃完。
examples.pinyin: Cài tài duō le, wǒmen méi quán dōu chī wán.
examples.en: The food was too much. We didn't finish eating it all.

title: Reduplication of adjectives
structure: AA + 的 (+ Noun)；AABB + 的 (+ Noun)；AABB + 地 + Verb；ABAB（作谓语）
explanation: 形容词重叠增强描述性。单音节用 AA，双音节用 AABB；作状语时 AABB + 地 + 动词；作谓语时可用 ABAB，相当于“一下”。并非所有形容词都能重叠。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de liǎn hóng hóng de.
examples.en: Your face is red.

examples.pinyin: Bǎobao de yǎnjing dà dà de.
examples.en: The baby's eyes are big.

examples.pinyin: Jīnwǎn de yuèliang yuán yuán de.
examples.en: The moon is round tonight.

examples.pinyin: Tā bàba gāo gāo pàng pàng de.
examples.en: Her father is tall and fat.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei shòu shòu xiǎo xiǎo de.
examples.en: My little sister is thin and small.

examples.zh: 我们清清楚楚地看到他跟一个胖胖的男人上车了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qīngqīng-chǔchǔ de kàndào tā gēn yīgè pàng pàng de nánrén shàngchē le.
examples.en: We clearly saw him get in the car with a fat man.

examples.pinyin: Lái, hē diǎn jiǔ, gāoxìng gāoxìng.
examples.en: Come on, have a little wine and enjoy yourself.

title: Turning adjectives into adverbs
structure: Adj. + 地 + Verb
explanation: 多数形容词加“地”变成副词，修饰动词，类似英语 -ly。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào nǔlì de xuéxí.
examples.en: You must study hard.

examples.pinyin: Yǔtiān dì huá, màn màn de zǒu.
examples.en: The floor is very slippery on rainy days. Walk slowly.

examples.pinyin: Tā shùnlì de tōngguò kǎoshì le.
examples.en: He passed the exam successfully.

examples.zh: 他认真地对我说：“我喜欢你。”
examples.pinyin: Tā rènzhēn de duì wǒ shuō: "Wǒ xǐhuan nǐ."
examples.en: In all seriousness, he said to me: "I like you."

examples.pinyin: Tā jīdòng de duì wǒ shuō "xièxie".
examples.en: She said "thank you" to me excitedly.

title: Expressing coincidence with "zhenghao"
structure: Subj. + 正好 + Verb / Adj.
explanation: “正好”表示恰好、刚好，可用于时间、大小、数量、程度等巧合。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái le! Wǒ zhènghǎo yào zhǎo nǐ.
examples.en: You are here! I was just looking for you.

examples.pinyin: Zhènghǎo nǐmen dōu shì dānshēn.
examples.en: You both happen to be single.

examples.zh: 我明天见他，正好可以问问他这件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān jiàn tā, zhènghǎo kěyǐ wènwen tā zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: I'm going to meet with him tomorrow. I can just ask him about this matter.

examples.zh: 我们正好也要去那儿，一起走吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhènghǎo yě yào qù nàr, yīqǐ zǒu ba.
examples.en: We just happen to be going there. Let's go together.

title: Continuation with "hai"
structure: Subj. + 还在 + [Verb Phrase]；……，Subj. + 还是 + [Verb Phrase]
explanation: “还”表示动作仍在继续（still）；“还是”表示尽管有情况，仍然如此。否定形式“还不/没 + 动词”常带“应该……却还没……”的语气。

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqing wǒ hái zài kǎolǜ.
examples.en: I am still thinking over this matter.

examples.pinyin: Yǐjīng zhōngwǔ le, tā hái zài shuì?
examples.en: It's already noon and he's still sleeping?

examples.zh: 我让他不要买，他还是买了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ ràng tā bùyào mǎi, tā háishì mǎi le.
examples.en: I told him not to buy it, but he still bought it.

examples.zh: 我们等了半个小时了，老师还没到。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen děng le bàn gè xiǎoshí le, lǎoshī hái méi dào.
examples.en: We've been waiting for half an hour, but the teacher still hasn't arrived.

examples.zh: 我解释了这么多遍，你还不懂？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiěshì le zhème duō biàn, nǐ hái bù dǒng?
examples.en: I've explained it so many times, and you still don't get it?

title: Emphasis with "jiushi"
structure: 就是 + Noun；就(是) + (不) + Verb
explanation: “就是”可强调“正是、就是”，也可表示“只是、就因为”，常带固执/任性语气。

examples.zh: 那个人就是她的新男朋友。
examples.pinyin: Nàge rén jiùshì tā de xīn nánpéngyou.
examples.en: That guy is her new boyfriend.

examples.pinyin: Tā jiùshì nǐ yào zhǎo de rén.
examples.en: He's just the person that you're looking for.

examples.zh: 他不去旅游就是不想花钱。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù qù lǚyóu jiùshì bù xiǎng huāqián.
examples.en: He didn't travel only because he doesn't want to spend the money.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiù yào qù!
examples.en: I just want to go!

examples.zh: 我父母就是不让我一个人去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ jiùshì bù ràng wǒ yīgèrén qù.
examples.en: My parents simply won't let me go alone.

title: Emphasizing negation with "you"
structure: 又 + 不/没 + Predicate
explanation: “又”用于否定前，强调“并没有/又不是”，常带反驳、不耐烦语气。

examples.pinyin: Wèn wǒ gànmá? Wǒ yòu bù zhīdào.
examples.en: Why ask me? I definitely don't know.

examples.zh: 这些菜又没坏，为什么要扔？
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē cài yòu méi huài, wèishénme yào rēng?
examples.en: These dishes haven't gone bad. Why would you throw them away?

examples.zh: 不要生气，我又不是故意的。
examples.pinyin: Bùyào shēngqì, wǒ yòu bù shì gùyì de.
examples.en: Don't be mad. It really wasn't on purpose.

examples.zh: 今天又不热，开空调干吗？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yòu bù rè, kāi kōngtiáo gànmá?
examples.en: It's not hot today. Why turn on the air conditioner?

title: Expressing "about to happen" with "jiu yao... le"
structure: (Subj. +) 就要 + Verb + 了；还有 + Time + 就(要) + Verb + 了
explanation: “就要……了”表示即将发生；“快要/快”也可替换。带“还有 + 时间”时强调还剩多久。

examples.pinyin: Jiù yào xiàyǔ le.
examples.en: It's about to rain.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen jiù yào jiéhūn le.
examples.en: They are about to get married.

examples.zh: 还有十分钟我就下班了。
examples.pinyin: Háiyǒu shí fēnzhōng wǒ jiù xiàbān le.
examples.en: I get off work in 10 minutes.

examples.zh: 还有两个星期我们就要考试了。
examples.pinyin: Háiyǒu liǎng gè xīngqī wǒmen jiù yào kǎoshì le.
examples.en: We're just two weeks away from the exam date.

title: Expressing "again" in the future with "zai"
structure: Subj. + 再 + Verb + Obj.；Subj. + 再 + Verb + Verb；再 + Verb + 一会儿
explanation: “再”表示将来再次发生；也可表示“继续做一会儿”。

examples.pinyin: Zài chī yīdiǎn.
examples.en: Eat some more.

examples.pinyin: Fúwùyuán, zài lái liǎng píng píjiǔ.
examples.en: Waiter, two more bottles of beer, please.

examples.pinyin: Zài gěi wǒ sān tiān shíjiān.
examples.en: Give me another three days.

examples.pinyin: Zài zhǎozhao.
examples.en: Keep looking.

examples.pinyin: Bié jí, zài xiǎngxiang.
examples.en: Don't worry. Keep thinking.

title: Expressing "again" in the past with "you"
structure: (Subj. +) 又 + Verb + 了；(Subj. +) 又 + 不/没 + Verb
explanation: “又”表示过去再次发生，常带不满或无奈。将来再次用“再”。

examples.pinyin: Yòu xiàyǔ le!
examples.en: It rained again!

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yòu chídào le.
examples.en: You're late again.

examples.pinyin: Bǎobao yòu kū le.
examples.en: The baby is crying again.

examples.pinyin: Tā yòu méi lái shàngkè.
examples.en: He didn't come to class again.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yòu yào jiābān le!
examples.en: We've got to work overtime again today!

title: Expressing "all along / it turns out" with "yuanlai"
structure: 原来 + 的 + Noun；Subj. + 原来 + Predicate；原来 + [New Information]
explanation: “原来”可表示“原来、从前”，也可表示突然明白“原来如此”。

examples.zh: 你原来的发型也很可爱。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yuánlái de fàxíng yě hěn kě'ài.
examples.en: Your original hairstyle was also very cute.

examples.zh: 她们原来只是邻居，现在是很好的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yuánlái zhǐ shì línjū, xiànzài shì hěn hǎo de péngyou.
examples.en: Originally they were just neighbors. Now they're very good friends.

examples.pinyin: Yuánlái shì nǐ!
examples.en: So it was you all along!

examples.pinyin: Yuánlái nǐmen rènshi!
examples.en: So you both knew each other this whole time!

examples.pinyin: Yuánlái shì zhèyàng!
examples.en: Oh, so it's like that!

title: Expressing "all at once" with "yixiazi"
structure: Subj. + 一下子 + Predicate + 了；Subj. + 一下子 + 就 + Predicate + 了
explanation: “一下子”表示事情发生得很快、突然，口语中也可用“一下”。

examples.pinyin: Tiānqì yīxiàzi biàn lěng le.
examples.en: The weather suddenly got cold.

examples.zh: 他一下子吃了三碗米饭。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīxiàzi chī le sān wǎn mǐfàn.
examples.en: He ate three bowls of rice all at once.

examples.zh: 老师进来以后，大家一下子就安静了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jìnlái yǐhòu, dàjiā yīxiàzi jiù ānjìng le.
examples.en: Everyone became silent after the teacher came in.

examples.zh: 看到那张照片，我一下子就想起来了。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào nà zhāng zhàopiàn, wǒ yīxiàzi jiù xiǎng qǐlái le.
examples.en: It all came back to me when I saw that picture.

title: Expressing "almost" with "chadian"
structure: Subj. + 差点 + Predicate (+ 了)；Subj. + 差点 + 就 + Predicate + 了
explanation: “差点”表示“几乎、差一点”，通常用于不希望发生的事，且实际没发生。

examples.pinyin: Chē chàdiǎn zhuàngdào wǒ.
examples.en: The car almost hit me.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chàdiǎn xiāngxìn tā.
examples.en: We almost believed him.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ chàdiǎn wàng le.
examples.en: I almost forgot.

examples.pinyin: Tā chàdiǎn jiù sǐ le.
examples.en: He almost died.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen duì chàdiǎn shū le.
examples.en: Our team almost lost.

title: Expressing "already" with "dou... le"
structure: 都 + Time + 了；Subj. + 都 + Predicate + 了
explanation: “都……了”强调“已经到某个时间/程度”，常带催促、惊讶。

examples.pinyin: Dōu jiǔ diǎn le, kuài diǎn qǐchuáng!
examples.en: It's already nine o'clock. Get out of bed!

examples.pinyin: Dōu shí'èr diǎn le, nǐ hái bù shuì?
examples.en: It's already 12 o'clock. Aren't you going to bed?

examples.pinyin: Fàn dōu liáng le, kuài chī ba.
examples.en: The food is cold already. Let's eat.

examples.zh: 他都道歉了，你别生气了。
examples.pinyin: Tā dōu dàoqiàn le, nǐ bié shēngqì le.
examples.en: He already apologized. Stop being so mad at him.

title: Expressing "always" with "conglai"
structure: Subj. + 从来 + 都 + Predicate
explanation: “从来 + 都”表示“一向、一直”，肯定句常用“都”。否定“从来不/没”表示“从不”。

examples.pinyin: Tā cónglái dōu zhèyàng.
examples.en: He's always like this.

examples.pinyin: Tā cónglái dōu zhème wǎn shuì.
examples.en: She's always gone to bed so late.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà cónglái dōu hěn dàshēng.
examples.en: He's always spoken very loudly.

examples.zh: 我们下棋，从来都是他赢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàqí, cónglái dōu shì tā yíng.
examples.en: He always wins when we play chess.

title: Expressing result with "jieguo"
structure: Reason / Condition，结果 + Result；Situation，结果 + [Unexpected Result]
explanation: “结果”表示“结果、最后”，可引出逻辑结果，也可引出意外/不理想的结果。

examples.zh: 她穿得很少，结果感冒了。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuān de hěn shǎo, jiéguǒ gǎnmào le.
examples.en: She didn't dress warmly enough, and as a result, she caught a cold.

examples.zh: 我太紧张了，结果说错了很多。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tài jǐnzhāng le, jiéguǒ shuō cuò le hěn duō.
examples.en: I was too nervous. As a result, I misspoke a lot.

examples.zh: 我去机场接他，结果没接到他。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù jīchǎng jiē tā, jiéguǒ méi jiēdào tā.
examples.en: I went to the airport to pick him up. But in the end, I didn't find him there.

examples.zh: 我昨天跟朋友去喝酒，结果喝醉了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān gēn péngyou qù hējiǔ, jiéguǒ hēzuì le.
examples.en: I went to have a drink with my friends yesterday. I ended up getting drunk.

similar: Stating the effect before the cause (B2)

title: Expressing "each other" with "huxiang"
structure: 互相 + Verb
explanation: “互相”表示“彼此”，多与双音节动词搭配。

examples.pinyin: hùxiāng bāngzhù
examples.en: help each other

examples.pinyin: hùxiāng liǎojiě
examples.en: know each other

examples.pinyin: hùxiāng zūnzhòng
examples.en: respect each other

examples.pinyin: hùxiāng zhīchí
examples.en: support each other

title: Expressing "enough" with "gou"
structure: Subj. + 够 + Verb / Adj. (+ 了)；Subj. + 不 + 够 + Adj. / Verb
explanation: “够”表示足够；否定“不够”表示不够。肯定句形容词后常加“了”，否定不加“了”。

examples.zh: 我们买了很多菜，够吃了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen mǎi le hěn duō cài, gòu chī le.
examples.en: We bought a lot of food. It's enough for us to eat.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhǐ gòu yòng ma?
examples.en: Is this paper enough for us to use?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì nǐ gòu hǎo le.
examples.en: I've been good enough to you.

examples.zh: 他觉得他女朋友不够漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Tā juéde tā nǚpéngyou bù gòu piàoliang.
examples.en: He thinks his girlfriend is not pretty enough.

examples.zh: 这些菜不够吃，再点几个菜。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē cài bù gòu chī, zài diǎn jǐ gè cài.
examples.en: This food is not enough for us to eat. Let's order a few more dishes.

title: Expressing "finally" with "zhongyu"
structure: Subj. + 终于 + Predicate + 了
explanation: “终于”表示经过长时间等待后终于发生，常带欣慰、轻松语气。不能单独使用。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhōngyú dào le!
examples.en: You've finally arrived!

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōngyú jiànmiàn le!
examples.en: We're finally meeting each other!

examples.pinyin: Zuòyè zhōngyú zuò wán le!
examples.en: I've finally finished my homework!

examples.pinyin: Zhège yuànwàng zhōngyú shíxiàn le!
examples.en: This dream has finally come true!

title: Expressing "had better" with "haishi"
structure: Subj. + 还是 + [Verb Phrase] + 吧
explanation: “还是”表示经过考虑后“还是……吧”，提出建议。否定句可省略“吧”。

examples.pinyin: Háishì míngtiān qù ba.
examples.en: We'd better go tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ háishì kuài diǎn zǒu ba.
examples.en: You'd better leave now.

examples.pinyin: Tài wǎn le, háishì xiān huíjiā ba.
examples.en: It's too late. We'd better go home now.

examples.pinyin: Tài guì le, háishì bié mǎi le.
examples.en: It's too expensive. You'd better not buy it.

title: Expressing "had better" with "zuihao"
structure: Subj. + 最好 + Predicate；Subj. + 最好 + 别/不要 + Predicate
explanation: “最好”表示建议或礼貌要求，“最好……”，否定“最好别/不要……”。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo xiān xiūxi yīxià.
examples.en: You'd better get some rest first.

examples.zh: 外面挺冷的，最好多穿点。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn tǐng lěng de, zuìhǎo duō chuān diǎn.
examples.en: It's pretty cold outside. Best to wear some more layers.

examples.pinyin: Zuìhǎo bié qù.
examples.en: You'd better not go.

examples.pinyin: Yǔ zhème dà, zuìhǎo bié chūmén.
examples.en: It's raining so heavily. It's best not to leave the house.

title: Expressing "this way" with "zheyang"
structure: 这样 + Verb；……，这样 + 会/才 + Predicate；这样的话，……
explanation: “这样”表示“这样、如此”，可引出方式、结果或假设条件“这样的话”。

examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò bù duì.
examples.en: Doing it this way is not right.

examples.zh: 你要多鼓励学生，这样他们会更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào duō gǔlì xuéshēng, zhèyàng tāmen huì gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.en: You need to encourage your students more. This will help them become more confident.

examples.zh: 你要多说，这样才能越来越流利。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào duō shuō, zhèyàng cái néng yuèláiyuè liúlì.
examples.en: You need to speak more. Only in this way will you become more and more fluent.

examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng de huà, nǐ hái xiǎng qù ma?
examples.en: If this is the case, do you still want to go?

title: Expressing "one by one" with "yi... yi..."
structure: 一 + Measure Word + 一 + Measure Word (+ Noun)；一 + Time Unit + 一 + Time Unit；一 + Measure Word (+ 又) + 一 + Measure Word
explanation: “一 + 量词 + 一 + 量词”表示逐个、一点一点；时间单位表示“一天天/一年年”；动量词表示反复。

examples.pinyin: Bié chǎo, yī gè yī gè shuō.
examples.en: Don't argue. Speak one by one.

examples.pinyin: Bié zháojí, yī diǎn yī diǎn zuò.
examples.en: Don't worry, do it little by little.

examples.pinyin: Bǎobao yī tiān yī tiān zài zhǎngdà.
examples.en: The baby is growing up day by day.

examples.zh: 我一遍一遍地跟他解释，他还是不听。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yī biàn yī biàn de gēn tā jiěshì, tā háishì bù tīng.
examples.en: I explained it to him again and again, but he still won't listen.

title: Expressing "only" with "jiu"
structure: 就 + Subj. + Predicate；Subj. + 就 + [Verb Phrase]；Subj. + 就 + Number + [Measure Word] + Noun
explanation: “就”表示“只、仅仅”，可放在主语前或谓语前，强调数量少。

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jiù wǒ zhīdào.
examples.en: I'm the only person that knows about this.

examples.zh: 大家都下班了，就老板还没走。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu xiàbān le, jiù lǎobǎn hái méi zǒu.
examples.en: Everyone finished work and left. Only the boss hasn't left.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiù qù guo yī cì.
examples.en: I've only been there once.

examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ jiù yī gè cèsuǒ?
examples.en: Does this place only have one bathroom?

title: Expressing duration of inaction
structure: Subj. + (已经 +) Duration + 没 + Verb + 了
explanation: 表示“多久没做某事”，时间放在主语后、动词前，动词用“没”否定，句末“了”。

examples.zh: 他们已经两天没吃东西了。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yǐjīng liǎng tiān méi chī dōngxi le.
examples.en: They haven't eaten anything for two days already.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng shí nián méi jiàn le.
examples.en: We haven't seen each other for ten years already.

examples.zh: 你多长时间没刮胡子了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ duō cháng shíjiān méi guā húzi le?
examples.en: How long has it been since you last shaved?

examples.pinyin: Tā bàn gè yuè méi chūmén le.
examples.en: It's been half a month since she's left the house.

title: Expressing earliness / soon with "jiu"
structure: Subj. + Time + 就 + Verb；Subj. + [Point in Time] + 就 + Verb + 了；早就 + Verb
explanation: “就”可表示“马上、很快”，也可表示“早于预期就……”。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎshàng jiù lái.
examples.en: I'll be there in a second.

examples.pinyin: Mǐfàn èrshí fēnzhōng jiù hǎo.
examples.en: The rice will be ready in 20 minutes.

examples.zh: 我们九点上课，他八点就来了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiǔ diǎn shàngkè, tā bā diǎn jiù lái le.
examples.en: We have class at nine, but he came in at eight.

examples.pinyin: Tā shí fēnzhōng jiù zuò wán le.
examples.en: It only took him ten minutes to finish doing it.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎo jiù zhīdào le!
examples.en: I knew that long ago!

similar: Events in quick succession with "yi... jiu..." (B1)

title: Expressing lateness with "cai"
structure: Subj. + Time + 才 + Verb
explanation: “才”表示“到……才”，强调晚于预期。后接动词一般不加“了”。

examples.zh: 我昨天晚上十一点才到家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang shíyī diǎn cái dào jiā.
examples.en: I didn't arrive at home until eleven o'clock last night.

examples.pinyin: Tā èrshíwǔ suì cái shàng dàxué.
examples.en: He didn't go to college until he was 25.

examples.pinyin: Tā sìshí suì cái jiéhūn.
examples.en: She didn't get married until she was forty.

examples.zh: 你怎么才来？我们等了半个多小时。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme cái lái? Wǒmen děng le bàn gè duō xiǎoshí.
examples.en: How come you came here so late? We've waited for more than half an hour.

title: Sequencing with "xian" and "zai"
structure: 先……，再……；先 + [Verb Phrase] + 再说
explanation: “先……再……”表示先做A再做B；“先……再说”表示先做这件事，之后再考虑。

examples.pinyin: Xiān xǐ shǒu zài chī.
examples.en: Wash your hands first, and then eat.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan xiān xǐzǎo, zài shuìjiào.
examples.en: I prefer to take a bath first and then go to bed.

examples.pinyin: Xiān chīfàn zàishuō.
examples.en: Let's eat first, then we'll talk.

examples.pinyin: Xiān xiūxi yīxià zàishuō.
examples.en: Let's rest a little first, then we'll see.

title: Using "always" as a complaint with "laoshi"
structure: 老是 + Predicate
explanation: “老是”表示“总是”，带不满或抱怨语气；也可用“老”。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme lǎoshì jiābān?
examples.en: Why are you always working late?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme lǎoshì bù gāoxìng?
examples.en: How are you always unhappy?

examples.pinyin: Bié lǎoshì bàoyuàn.
examples.en: Stop complaining all the time.

examples.pinyin: Zhège jīqì lǎoshì chū wèntí.
examples.en: There is always something wrong with this machine.

title: Using "cai" for small numbers
structure: 才 + Number + [Measure Word] + Noun；才 + Verb + Number + Measure Word + Noun
explanation: “才”强调数量少，相当于“only / just”。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ cái èrshí suì?
examples.en: You're only twenty?

examples.pinyin: Zhège bān cái liǎng gè xuésheng.
examples.en: This class only has two students.

examples.zh: 这顿饭才二十块，太便宜了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè dùn fàn cái èrshí kuài, tài piányi le!
examples.en: This meal only cost twenty kuai. It's too cheap!

examples.pinyin: Tā cái lái le liǎng gè yuè.
examples.en: She's been here for only two months.

title: Using "ye" and "dou" together
structure: Subj. + 也都 + Predicate；Subj. + 也都 + 不/没 + Predicate
explanation: “也都”表示“也都……”，强调多个对象具有共同点。否定词放在“也都”后。

examples.zh: 我很好，我的家人也都很好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn hǎo, wǒ de jiārén yě dōu hěn hǎo.
examples.en: I'm good. So is everyone in my family.

examples.zh: 大人很喜欢这个餐厅，孩子们也都很喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Dàren hěn xǐhuan zhège cāntīng, háizimen yě dōu hěn xǐhuan.
examples.en: Adults all like this restaurant, and the children all like it too.

examples.zh: 我们也都没吃饭，一起去吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yě dōu méi chīfàn, yīqǐ qù ba.
examples.en: We all haven't eaten either. Let's go together.

examples.zh: 我不喜欢蝙蝠侠，我的朋友也都不喜欢他。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuan Biānfúxiá, wǒ de péngyou yě dōu bù xǐhuan tā.
examples.en: I don't like Batman. My friends don't like him, either.

title: Adjectives with "zheme" and "name"
structure: Subj. + 这么/那么 + Adj.
explanation: “这么/那么 + 形容词”表示“这么/那么……”，强调程度。

examples.zh: 他说话这么快，你们听得懂吗？
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà zhème kuài, nǐmen tīng de dǒng ma?
examples.en: He speaks so fast. Can you guys understand?

examples.zh: 我没想到这个考试这么难。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎngdào zhège kǎoshì zhème nán.
examples.en: I didn't expect this exam would be this difficult.

examples.pinyin: Yǔ zhème dà, míngtiān zài qù ba.
examples.en: The rain is so heavy. How about we go tomorrow?

examples.zh: 你那么聪明，一定能猜到。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ nàme cōngming, yīdìng néng cāidào.
examples.en: You're so smart. You can definitely guess it.

title: Expressing "quite" with "ting"
structure: 挺 + Adj. + 的；挺 + [Verb Phrase] + 的
explanation: “挺……的”表示“挺、相当”，口语常用。可接形容词或心理动词。

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu tǐng xiǎng nǐ de.
examples.en: We all quite miss you.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ tǐng xǐhuan zhè fèn gōngzuò de.
examples.en: I quite like this job.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǚ'ér tǐng pà tā bàba de.
examples.en: My daughter is quite afraid of his father.

examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn shì wǒ tǐng hòuhuǐ de.
examples.en: I rather regret that incident.

title: Expressing "rather" with "bijiao"
structure: Subj. + 比较 + Adj.；Subj. + 比较 + [Verb Phrase]
explanation: “比较”作副词表示“比较、相当、rather”，可接形容词或心理动词。

examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bǐjiào jiǎndān.
examples.en: This question is quite easy.

examples.zh: 我觉得这个价格比较贵。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhège jiàgé bǐjiào guì.
examples.en: I think this price is rather expensive.

examples.zh: 我比较讨厌男人说脏话。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǐjiào tǎoyàn nánrén shuō zānghuà.
examples.en: I quite hate it when men use foul language.

examples.zh: 我父母比较反对我找外国男朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ bǐjiào fǎnduì wǒ zhǎo wàiguó nánpéngyou.
examples.en: My parents rather object to me seeking a foreign boyfriend.

title: Ending a non-exhaustive list with "shenme de"
structure: Noun 1, Noun 2 (+ Noun 3) + 什么的
explanation: “什么的”表示“……之类的”，用于列举未尽。

examples.zh: 我奶奶不吃肉，只吃蔬菜、豆腐什么的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bù chī ròu, zhǐ chī shūcài, dòufu shénme de.
examples.en: My grandma doesn't eat meat. She only eats vegetables, tofu, and so on.

examples.zh: 养狗很麻烦，你要喂它，给它洗澡，跟它玩什么的。
examples.pinyin: Yǎng gǒu hěn máfan, nǐ yào wèi tā, gěi tā xǐzǎo, gēn tā wán shénme de.
examples.en: Having a dog is too much trouble. You need to feed it, give it a bath, play with it, and so on.

examples.zh: 我喜欢实用的礼物，手表、衣服、书什么的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan shíyòng de lǐwù, shǒubiǎo, yīfu, shū shénme de.
examples.en: I like practical presents: watches, clothes, books, and so on.

examples.zh: 明天去野餐，我们要不要买一些水果、零食什么的？
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān qù yěcān, wǒmen yào bu yào mǎi yīxiē shuǐguǒ, língshí shénme de?
examples.en: We are going on picnic tomorrow. Shall we buy some fruits, snacks, and so on?

title: Expressing "stuff like that" with "zhileide"
structure: (像) …… 之类的 + [Category]
explanation: “之类的”表示“……之类的”，用于列举同类事物。

examples.zh: 我家附近有很多像KFC之类的快餐店。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu hěn duō xiàng KFC zhī lèi de kuàicān diàn.
examples.en: There are many fast-food restaurants in my neighborhood, like KFC and others like it.

examples.zh: 你喜欢《星球大战》之类的电影吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan 《Xīngqiú Dàzhàn》 zhī lèi de diànyǐng ma?
examples.en: Do you like movies like Star Wars?

examples.zh: 她很适合做像市场推广之类的工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn shìhé zuò xiàng shìchǎng tuīguǎng zhī lèi de gōngzuò.
examples.en: She's very suitable for jobs like marketing and similar.

examples.zh: 年轻人很喜欢用像支付宝之类的电子支付方式。
examples.pinyin: Niánqīngrén hěn xǐhuan yòng xiàng Zhīfùbǎo zhī lèi de diànzǐ zhīfù fāngshì.
examples.en: Young people love using electronic methods of payment like Alipay and similar.

similar: Ending a non-exhaustive list with "shenme de" (B1)

title: Non-exhaustive lists with "dengdeng"
structure: A1，A2 …… 等/等等；A1，A2 …… 等 + [Category] + Predicate
explanation: “等/等等”表示“……等、等等”，较正式。可后接类别名词。

examples.zh: 西瓜、菠萝、葡萄等等，我都喜欢吃。
examples.pinyin: Xīguā, bōluó, pútao děngděng, wǒ dōu xǐhuan chī.
examples.en: Watermelons, pineapples, grapes, and so on... I like them all.

examples.zh: 我爸爸很喜欢运动，比如跑步、游泳、打羽毛球等等。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba hěn xǐhuan yùndòng, bǐrú pǎobù, yóuyǒng, dǎ yǔmáoqiú děngděng.
examples.en: My father likes different sports, for example, running, swimming, playing badminton, etc.

examples.zh: 长城、故宫等景点都是北京有名的景点。
examples.pinyin: Chángchéng, Gùgōng děng jǐngdiǎn dōu shì Běijīng yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.en: The Great Wall, the Forbidden City, etc. are all famous tourist attractions in Beijing.

examples.zh: 北京、上海、广州等城市的经济都很发达。
examples.pinyin: Běijīng, Shànghǎi, Guǎngzhōu děng chéngshì de jīngjì dōu hěn fādá.
examples.en: Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou and so on are economically developed cities.

title: A softer "but" with "buguo"
explanation: “不过”表示“但是、不过”，比“可是/但是”更口语、更委婉。

examples.zh: 这件衣服我很喜欢，不过有点贵。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu wǒ hěn xǐhuan, bùguò yǒudiǎn guì.
examples.en: I like this piece of clothing, but it's a little bit expensive.

examples.zh: 这个学生很聪明，不过有点懒。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xuéshēng hěn cōngming, bùguò yǒudiǎn lǎn.
examples.en: This student is very smart, but he's a little lazy.

examples.zh: 他是东北人，不过他没有口音。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì dōngběi rén, bùguò tā méiyǒu kǒuyīn.
examples.en: He's from the northeast, but he doesn't have the accent.

examples.zh: 我的钱包丢了，不过没丢什么重要的东西。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, bùguò méi diū shénme zhòngyào de dōngxi.
examples.en: I lost my wallet, but I didn't lose anything important.

title: Expressing "how about" with "yaobu"
structure: Reason/Situation，要不 + Suggestion；要不 + Suggestion，Reason/Situation
explanation: “要不”表示提出建议“要不……吧”，也可表示“否则”（要不然）。

examples.zh: 大家都有点累了，要不休息一会儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu yǒudiǎn lèi le, yàobù xiūxi yīhuìr ba.
examples.en: Everyone is a little tired. Let's rest for a while.

examples.zh: 要不我们一起去吧，一个人去没意思。
examples.pinyin: Yàobù wǒmen yīqǐ qù ba, yīgèrén qù méi yìsi.
examples.en: How about we go together? It's no fun to go by myself.

examples.zh: 这个星期我比较忙，要不下个星期见？
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī wǒ bǐjiào máng, yàobù xià gè xīngqī jiàn?
examples.en: I'm pretty busy this week. How about we meet up next week?

examples.pinyin: Dǎchē ba, yàobù chídào de.
examples.en: Take a taxi. Otherwise, you'll be late.

title: Expressing "in addition" with "haiyou"
explanation: “还有”表示“另外、还有”，用于补充新信息。

examples.zh: 你需要吃药。还有，要多休息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xūyào chī yào. Háiyǒu, yào duō xiūxi.
examples.en: You need to take medicine. Also, you should get more rest.

examples.zh: 我要大杯，不要冰，还有，少放糖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào dà bēi, bùyào bīng. Háiyǒu, shǎo fàng táng.
examples.en: I want a large drink, no ice. Also, just a little sugar, please.

examples.zh: 不要一边吃饭一边说话。还有，别吃那么快。
examples.pinyin: Bùyào yībiān chīfàn yībiān shuōhuà. Háiyǒu, bié chī nàme kuài.
examples.en: Don't talk while you eat. Also, don't eat so fast.

examples.zh: 酒店谁来订？还有，机票买了吗？
examples.pinyin: Jiǔdiàn shéi lái dìng? Háiyǒu, jīpiào mǎi hǎo le ma?
examples.en: Who's going to book the hotel room? Also, did you buy the plane tickets?

title: Expressing "in addition" with "lingwai"
structure: ……，另外，……；另外 + [Verb Phrase]
explanation: “另外”表示“另外、此外”，可连接句子，也可作副词修饰动词。

examples.zh: 这个课文太难了，我不想学。另外，我也没准备。
examples.pinyin: Zhège kèwén tài nán le, wǒ bù xiǎng xué. Lìngwài, wǒ yě méi zhǔnbèi.
examples.en: This lesson is too difficult and I don't want to read it. Besides, I didn't prepare for it.

examples.zh: 希望你不要再迟到了。另外，你应该穿得正式一点。
examples.pinyin: Xīwàng nǐ bùyào zài chídào le. Lìngwài, nǐ yīnggāi chuān de zhèngshì yīdiǎn.
examples.en: I hope you won't be late again. In addition, you should also dress a bit more formally.

examples.zh: 今天我没空，能不能另外安排时间？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ méi kòng, néng bu néng lìngwài ānpái shíjiān?
examples.en: I don't have time today. Can you schedule it another time?

examples.zh: 这里VIP室，要另外付费才能用。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ shì VIP shì, yào lìngwài fùfèi cái néng yòng.
examples.en: This is the VIP room. You will have to pay extra in order to use it.

title: Expressing "in addition" with "zaishuo"
explanation: “再说”表示“况且、再说”，补充支持理由。

examples.zh: 这么晚，别走了。再说，外面正在下雪。
examples.pinyin: Zhème wǎn, bié zǒu le. Zàishuō, wàimiàn zhèngzài xiàxuě.
examples.en: It's so late. Stay. Besides, it's snowing outside.

examples.zh: 他喜欢，就让他去吧。再说，他在家也没事干。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan, jiù ràng tā qù ba. Zàishuō, tā zài jiā yě méi shì gàn.
examples.en: He likes it. Just let him go. Besides, he's got nothing to do at home.

examples.zh: 那件衣服太贵了，我没买。再说，我也不是很喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn yīfu tài guì le, wǒ méi mǎi. Zàishuō, wǒ yě bù shì hěn xǐhuan.
examples.en: That piece of clothing is too expensive. I didn't buy it. Besides, I didn't like it so much.

examples.zh: 别吃了，你已经吃了五个了。再说，我们还没吃呢。
examples.pinyin: Bié chī le, nǐ yǐjīng chī le wǔ gè le. Zàishuō, wǒmen hái méi chī ne.
examples.en: Stop eating. You've already eaten five. Besides, the rest of us haven't eaten yet.

title: Expressing "then…" with "name"
structure: Situation，那么/那 + Suggestion/Decision
explanation: “那么/那”表示“那么、既然这样”，引出判断或决定。

examples.zh: 他不听，那我应该怎么办？
examples.pinyin: Tā bù tīng, nà wǒ yīnggāi zěnme bàn?
examples.en: He won't listen. So what should I do?

examples.zh: 大家都到了，那么我们开始吧。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu dào le, nàme wǒmen kāishǐ ba.
examples.en: Everybody is here, so let's begin.

examples.pinyin: Yǔ tíng le, nà wǒmen zǒu ba.
examples.en: The rain has stopped, so let's leave.

examples.zh: 他学过十年中文？那他的中文说得很好吧？
examples.pinyin: Tā xué guo shí nián Zhōngwén? Nà tā de Zhōngwén shuō de hěn hǎo ba?
examples.en: He's studied Chinese for ten years? So he must speak Chinese really well, then?

title: Using "lai" to connect two verb phrases
structure: 通过/用 + Method + 来 + [Verb Phrase]
explanation: “来”连接两个动词短语，表示“用来/以便”，前常接方法。

examples.zh: 用这种方法来赚钱，真丢人。
examples.pinyin: Yòng zhè zhǒng fāngfǎ lái zhuànqián, zhēn diūrén.
examples.en: It's shameful to earn money in this way.

examples.zh: 很多年轻人用手机APP来点外卖。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīngrén yòng shǒujī APP lái diǎn wàimài.
examples.en: A lot of young people use apps on their cell phones to order food.

examples.zh: 你可以通过微信来关注我们。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ tōngguò Wēixìn lái guānzhù wǒmen.
examples.en: You can follow us on WeChat.

examples.zh: 我们需要通过培训来提高服务质量。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào tōngguò péixùn lái tígāo fúwù zhìliàng.
examples.en: We need to improve our service quality through training.

title: Expressing "before" and "after" with "zhiqian" and "zhihou"
structure: Event + 之前/之后，……；……，之前/之后……
explanation: “之前/之后”表示“在……之前/之后”，比“以前/以后”稍正式。

examples.zh: 来中国之前，我的汉语很一般。
examples.pinyin: Lái Zhōngguó zhīqián, wǒ de Hànyǔ hěn yībān.
examples.en: Before I came to China, my Chinese was really mediocre.

examples.zh: 下班之后给我打个电话。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān zhīhòu gěi wǒ dǎ gè diànhuà.
examples.en: Give me a call after you get off work.

examples.zh: 出国之前，他和女朋友分手了。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó zhīqián, tā hé nǚpéngyou fēnshǒu le.
examples.en: Before he went abroad, he broke up with his girlfriend.

examples.zh: 她在英国读完了大学，之后回上海了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Yīngguó dú wán le dàxué, zhīhòu huí Shànghǎi le.
examples.en: She finished university in England. Afterwards, she returned to Shanghai.

similar: In the future in general with "yihou" (A2)

title: Expressing "ever since" with "yilai"
structure: Time/Event + 以来，……；Time Period + 来，……
explanation: “以来”表示“自从……以来”；“来”只能接时间段，不接具体日期。

examples.zh: 今年八月以来，这里一直没下过雨。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián Bāyuè yǐlái, zhèlǐ yīzhí méi xià guo yǔ.
examples.en: It hasn't rained since August of this year.

examples.zh: 结婚以来，我们没吵过架。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn yǐlái, wǒmen méi chǎo guo jià.
examples.en: Since we got married we haven't had a fight.

examples.pinyin: Shí nián lái, fángjià yīzhí zài zhǎng.
examples.en: For the past decade, housing prices have been continuously going up.

examples.zh: 几个月来，我们公司的收入一直在增加。
examples.pinyin: Jǐ gè yuè lái, wǒmen gōngsī de shōurù yīzhí zài zēngjiā.
examples.en: Our company's income has been steadily increasing over the past few months.

title: Expressing "when" with "shi"
structure: Time + 时，Subj. ……；Subj. + Time + 时，……
explanation: “时”表示“……的时候”，比“的时候”更正式。

examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì shí bùyào shuōhuà.
examples.en: Don't talk when you're taking a test.

examples.zh: 我面试时经常会问这个问题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ miànshì shí jīngcháng huì wèn zhège wèntí.
examples.en: I often ask this question during job interviews.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ shēngqì shí bù xiǎng shuōhuà.
examples.en: I don't want to talk when I'm angry.

examples.zh: 飞机起飞时，他关了手机和电脑。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī qǐfēi shí, tā guān le shǒujī hé diànnǎo.
examples.en: When the plane took off, he turned off his cell phone and computer.

title: Sequencing past events with "houlai"
structure: [Past Event 1]，后来，[Past Event 2]
explanation: “后来”表示“后来、之后”，只能用于已经发生的两件事之间。

examples.zh: 他说他会来，后来说又不来了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì lái, hòulái yòu shuō bù lái le.
examples.en: He said he would come, but later he said that he's not coming.

examples.zh: 他们上周吵架了，后来和好了。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen shàng zhōu chǎojià le, hòulái héhǎo le.
examples.en: They had a fight last week, and they made up afterwards.

examples.zh: 他以前是厨师，后来当了老板。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐqián shì chúshī, hòulái dāng le lǎobǎn.
examples.en: He used to be a chef. Afterwards, he became the owner.

examples.zh: 开始我父母不同意，后来他们同意了。
examples.pinyin: Kāishǐ wǒ fùmǔ bù tóngyì, hòulái tāmen tóngyì le.
examples.en: My parents disapproved in the beginning, but they approved later.

similar: In the future in general with "yihou" (A2)

title: Expressing fractions with "fenzhi"
structure: Denominator + 分之 + Numerator
explanation: “分之”表示分数，先说分母，再说分子。百分比用“百分之……”。

examples.zh: 我的手机电量只有百分之五了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī diànliàng zhǐ yǒu bǎi fēn zhī wǔ le.
examples.en: My phone only has 5% power left.

examples.zh: 这个文件已经下载了三分之二。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wénjiàn yǐjīng xiàzài le sān fēn zhī èr.
examples.en: This document is two-thirds downloaded.

examples.zh: 这篇文章有五分之三是抄别人的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng yǒu wǔ fēn zhī sān shì chāo biérén de.
examples.en: Three fifths of this article has been copied from others.

examples.zh: 差不多三分之一的美国人有护照。
examples.pinyin: Chàbuduō sān fēn zhī yī de Měiguórén yǒu hùzhào.
examples.en: About one third of Americans have passports.

title: Indicating a number in excess with "duo"
structure: Number + 多 + [Measure word] (+ Noun)
explanation: “多”放在数量词后表示“多、超过”。小于十一时“多”可在量词后；大于十一时“多”在量词前。

examples.zh: 我妈妈已经五十多岁了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma yǐjīng wǔshí duō suì le.
examples.en: My mother is over fifty.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu le liǎng gè duō xiǎoshí.
examples.en: We walked for more than two hours.

examples.zh: 这个班有两百多个学生。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bān yǒu liǎngbǎi duō gè xuésheng.
examples.en: There are more than two hundred students in this class.

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǒu yīqiān duō yè.
examples.en: This book has more than a thousand pages.

title: Advanced yes-no questions with "ma"
structure: Confirmation + Question + 吗？
explanation: “知道/了解/明白/认识…… + 疑问词 + 吗？”表示确认型问句，比普通“吗”问句更具体。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào zhè shì shénme ma?
examples.en: Do you know what this is?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào tā shì shéi ma?
examples.en: Do you know who he is?

examples.zh: 你们明白这个标志是什么意思吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen míngbai zhège biāozhì shì shénme yìsi ma?
examples.en: Do you all understand what this symbol means?

examples.zh: 你能再说一遍你的问题是什么吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng zài shuō yī biàn nǐ de wèntí shì shénme ma?
examples.en: Can you repeat what your question is?

title: Aspect particle "zhe"
structure: Verb + 着；Verb 1 + 着 + Verb 2；Subj. + 是 + Verb + 着 + 玩 + 的
explanation: “着”表示持续状态或方式；也可用于固定口语“听着、拿着、等着”；“说着玩的”表示“开玩笑”。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ dú, nǐ tīng zhe.
examples.en: I'll read, and you listen.

examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zuò zhe, wǒ mǎshàng huílái.
examples.en: Sit for a while. I'll be right back.

examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan zhàn zhe chīfàn.
examples.en: She likes to eat standing up.

examples.zh: 公司门开着，可是没人在。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī mén kāi zhe, kěshì méi rén zài.
examples.en: The office door is open but no one is in there.

examples.zh: 你不要生气，我是说着玩的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bùyào shēngqì, wǒ shì shuō zhe wán de.
examples.en: Don't be mad. I was just joking.

title: Expressing the self-evident with "ma"
structure: Statement + 嘛
explanation: “嘛”表示“显而易见、本来如此”，语气轻松。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ mèimei hěn piàoliang ma.
examples.en: Your sister is pretty.

examples.pinyin: Bù xiǎng qù jiù bùyào qù ma.
examples.en: If you don't wanna go, don't go.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā yǒu huà jiù shuō ma.
examples.en: Guys, just say whatever you have to say.

examples.pinyin: Kāi màn diǎn, ānquán dìyī ma.
examples.en: Drive slowly. Safety first.

title: Reviewing options with "ba"
structure: Option 1 + 吧，……；Option 2 + 吧，……
explanation: 两个“吧”列举两个选择，表示犹豫不决，常带负面语气。

examples.zh: 冬天去吧，太冷；夏天去吧，太热。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān qù ba, tài lěng; xiàtiān qù ba, tài rè.
examples.en: If we go in the winter, it's too cold. If we go in the summer, it's too hot.

examples.zh: 早点去吧，要等；晚点去吧，会堵车。
examples.pinyin: Zǎo diǎn qù ba, yào děng; wǎn diǎn qù ba, huì dǔchē.
examples.en: If we go early, we'll have to wait. If we go later, there will be bad traffic.

examples.zh: 去吧，要给红包；不去吧，他没面子。
examples.pinyin: Qù ba, yào gěi hóngbāo; bù qù ba, tā méi miànzi.
examples.en: I need to give a red envelope if I go. If I don't go, he will lose face.

examples.zh: 说吧，他肯定会做错；不说吧，他肯定不高兴。
examples.pinyin: Shuō ba, tā hái huì zuò cuò; bù shuō ba, tā kěndìng bù gāoxìng.
examples.en: If I don't tell him, he will still do it wrong next time. If I do tell him, he will get upset.

title: Using "de" (modal particle)
structure: Statement + 的
explanation: 句末“的”表示肯定、确信的语气，常与“会/一定”搭配。

examples.pinyin: Tā huì hǎo de.
examples.en: He will get better.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ de.
examples.en: You can do this.

examples.pinyin: Tā yīdìng huì lái de.
examples.en: She's definitely coming.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù huì piàn nǐ de.
examples.en: I won't lie to you.

similar: The "shi... de" construction for emphasizing details (B1)
The "shi... de" construction for indicating purpose (B1)

title: Expressing "about" with "guanyu"
structure: 关于 + Obj.，……；关于…… 的 + Noun
explanation: “关于”表示“关于”，可作状语放句首，也可作定语加“的”。

examples.zh: 关于中国历史，我知道的不多。
examples.pinyin: Guānyú Zhōngguó lìshǐ, wǒ zhīdào de bù duō.
examples.en: As for Chinese history, I don't know a lot.

examples.zh: 关于这次考试，我还有几个问题要问。
examples.pinyin: Guānyú zhè cì kǎoshì, wǒ hái yǒu jǐ gè wèntí yào wèn.
examples.en: As for this exam, I still have a few questions that I need to ask.

examples.zh: 网上有很多关于这件事情的评论。
examples.pinyin: Wǎngshang yǒu hěn duō guānyú zhè jiàn shìqing de pínglùn.
examples.en: There are lots of comments about this matter online.

examples.zh: 这是一份关于中国奢侈品市场的报告。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yī fèn guānyú Zhōngguó shēchǐpǐn shìchǎng de bàogào.
examples.en: This is a report about the Chinese luxury market.

title: Expressing "all the way until" with "zhidao"
structure: 直到 + Time/Event，Subj. + 才……；直到 + Time/Event，Subj. + 都 + 不/没……
explanation: “直到……才……”表示“直到……才……”；否定“直到……都没……”表示“直到……都没……”。

examples.zh: 直到十二点半，我才做完作业。
examples.pinyin: Zhídào shí'èr diǎn bàn, wǒ cái zuò wán zuòyè.
examples.en: It wasn't until twelve thirty in the morning that I finished my homework.

examples.zh: 直到半个月以后，我的感冒才好。
examples.pinyin: Zhídào bàn gè yuè yǐhòu, wǒ de gǎnmào cái hǎo.
examples.en: It took me half a month to recover from the cold.

examples.zh: 直到他搬到上海，我们都没见过。
examples.pinyin: Zhídào tā bān dào Shànghǎi, wǒmen dōu méi jiàn guo.
examples.en: We didn't meet until he moved to Shanghai.

examples.zh: 直到电影结束，他都没来。
examples.pinyin: Zhídào diànyǐng jiéshù, tā dōu méi lái.
examples.en: He didn't show up until the movie was over.

title: Expressing "for" with "gei"
structure: Subj. + 给 + Recipient + [Verb Phrase]
explanation: “给 + 人 + 动词”表示“为/给某人做某事”。

examples.pinyin: Gěi kèrén dàochá.
examples.en: Pour tea for the guests.

examples.pinyin: Māma zài gěi háizimen zuòfàn.
examples.en: Mom cooks for the kids.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ ná yī shuāng kuàizi.
examples.en: Please get a pair of chopsticks for me.

examples.zh: 这个周末我们给儿子开生日派对。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒmen gěi érzi kāi shēngrì pàiduì.
examples.en: We're going to hold a birthday party for our son this weekend.

title: Expressing "for" with "wei"
structure: 为 + Party + Verb / Adj.
explanation: “为 + 人/组织 + 动词”表示“为……”，比“给”正式。

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu wèi nǐ gāoxìng.
examples.en: We are all happy for you.

examples.pinyin: Shéi wèi wǒ kǎolǜ guo?
examples.en: Who has ever considered me?

examples.zh: 她是为美国政府工作的。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì wèi Měiguó zhèngfǔ gōngzuò de.
examples.en: She works for the United States government.

examples.zh: 这个生日蛋糕是为你准备的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shēngrì dàngāo shì wèi nǐ zhǔnbèi de.
examples.en: This birthday cake has been prepared for you.

title: Expressing "less than" with "budao"
structure: Subj. + 不到 + Number + [Measure Word] + Noun；Subj. + 不到 + Time + 就 + Predicate + 了
explanation: “不到”表示“不到、少于”；“不到……就……”表示“不到……就……”。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǚ'ér bùdào sān suì.
examples.en: My daughter is not yet three years old.

examples.zh: 这件衣服花了不到一百块。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu huā le bùdào yībǎi kuài.
examples.en: On this piece of clothing I spent less than 100 RMB.

examples.zh: 她的病不到一个星期就好了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de bìng bùdào yī gè xīngqī jiù hǎo le.
examples.en: Her sickness got better in less than a week.

examples.zh: 他们认识不到两个月就结婚了。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen rènshi bùdào liǎng gè yuè jiù jiéhūn le.
examples.en: After knowing each other for less than two months they got married.

title: Expressing "toward" with "wang"
structure: 往 + Direction/Place + Verb；Verb + 往 + Direction/Place；往下 + Verb
explanation: “往”表示方向“往……”，可放动词前；书面也可放动词后；“往下”表示“继续下去”。

examples.pinyin: Yīzhí wǎng qián zǒu.
examples.en: Go straight ahead.

examples.pinyin: Wǎng zuǒ guǎi.
examples.en: Turn left.

examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu wǎng dōng pǎo le.
examples.en: That thief ran towards the east.

examples.pinyin: Wǎng xià shuō.
examples.en: Keep talking.

title: Expressing "towards" with "xiang"
structure: 向 + Direction/Person + Verb
explanation: “向”表示方向“朝/向……”，也可表示对象“向某人……”。

examples.pinyin: Xiàng dōng zǒu.
examples.en: Walk to the east.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī zhèng xiàng wǒmen zǒu lái.
examples.en: The teacher is currently walking towards us.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bìxū xiàng tā dàoqiàn!
examples.en: You must apologize to him!

examples.zh: 这件事你应该向老板汇报一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ yīnggāi xiàng lǎobǎn huìbào yīxià.
examples.en: You should report this matter to the boss!

title: Idiomatic phrases with "zai"
structure: 在 + Topic + 上/下/方面，Subj. ……
explanation: “在……上/下/方面”表示“在……方面/情况下/关于……”。

examples.zh: 在这个问题上，我们的看法是一样的。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège wèntí shàng, wǒmen de kànfǎ shì yīyàng de.
examples.en: In regards to this problem, our opinions are the same.

examples.zh: 在这样的环境下长大，孩子会快乐吗？
examples.pinyin: Zài zhèyàng de huánjìng xià zhǎngdà, háizi huì kuàilè ma?
examples.en: Do you think kids will be happy growing up in this kind of environment?

examples.zh: 在事业方面，我老板很成功。
examples.pinyin: Zài shìyè fāngmiàn, wǒ lǎobǎn hěn chénggōng.
examples.en: With regards to career, my boss is very successful.

examples.pinyin: Zài jìshù fāngmiàn, tā shì zhuānjiā.
examples.en: When it comes to technology, he's an expert.

similar: Expressing location with "zai... shang / xia / li" (A2)

title: Using "dui" with verbs
structure: Subj. + 对 + Person + Verb；对……感兴趣/负责/满意/失望/好奇
explanation: “对 + 对象 + 动词”表示“对/向……”，常用于心理动词或固定搭配。

examples.pinyin: Bǎobao duì wǒ xiào le.
examples.en: The baby smiled at me.

examples.zh: 你不应该这样对父母说话。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù yīnggāi zhèyàng duì fùmǔ shuōhuà.
examples.en: You shouldn't talk to your parents this way.

examples.zh: 我儿子对学外语很感兴趣。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ érzi duì xué wàiyǔ hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.en: My son is very interested in learning foreign languages.

examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn duì nǐ bù mǎnyì.
examples.en: The boss is not very satisfied with you.

title: Appearance with "kanqilai"
structure: Subj. + 看起来 + Adj.；Subj. + 看起来 + 像 + Noun Phrase
explanation: “看起来”表示“看起来……”，可接形容词或“像……”。

examples.pinyin: Dàngāo kànqǐlái hěn hǎochī.
examples.en: The cake looks really tasty.

examples.zh: 你男朋友看起来很成熟。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ nánpéngyou kànqǐlái hěn chéngshú.
examples.en: Your boyfriend looks very mature.

examples.zh: 你妈妈真年轻！看起来像你姐姐。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ māma zhēn niánqīng! Kànqǐlái xiàng nǐ jiějie.
examples.en: Your mother is so young! She looks like your older sister.

examples.pinyin: Nǐmen liǎ kànqǐlái xiàng qínglǚ.
examples.en: You two look like a couple.

title: Causative verbs
structure: Subj. + [Causative Verb] + Person + Predicate
explanation: “让/叫/请/使”表示使役，“让/叫”口语，“使”书面。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme bù ràng wǒ qù?
examples.en: Why won't you let me go?

examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng ràng rén hěn gǎndòng.
examples.en: This movie really moves people.

examples.zh: 他偷偷约别的女孩，你叫怎么想？
examples.pinyin: Tā tōutōu yuē bié de nǚhái, nǐ jiào wǒ zěnme xiǎng?
examples.en: He secretly asked other girls out. Tell me what I'm supposed to think.

examples.zh: 他的演讲使听众们非常激动。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yǎnjiǎng shǐ tīngzhòngmen fēicháng jīdòng.
examples.en: His speech made the audience very excited.

title: Expressing "it depends" with "kan"
structure: 这/那 + 要看/得看 + [Unclear Situation]；[Unknown Outcome] + 要看/得看 + [Unclear Situation]
explanation: “要看/得看”表示“取决于……”。

examples.pinyin: Zhè děi kàn nǐ de shíjiān.
examples.en: This depends on when you are available.

examples.pinyin: Nà yào kàn tā yuàn bu yuànyì.
examples.en: That depends on whether he is willing or not.

examples.pinyin: Qù bu qù děi kàn wǒ de xīnqíng.
examples.en: Whether or not I go depends on my mood.

examples.zh: 什么时候去要看公司的安排。
examples.pinyin: Shénme shíhou qù yào kàn gōngsī de ānpái.
examples.en: When we go depends on the company's arrangements.

title: Expressing "it seems" with "haoxiang"
structure: Subj. + 好像……
explanation: “好像”表示“好像、似乎”。

examples.pinyin: Tā hǎoxiàng shì Yīngguórén.
examples.en: He seems to be British.

examples.pinyin: Tā hǎoxiàng shēngbìng le.
examples.en: It seems like she's sick.

examples.pinyin: Hǎoxiàng yào xiàyǔ le.
examples.en: It seems like it's going to rain.

examples.pinyin: Hǎoxiàng yǒu rén qiāomén.
examples.en: It seems that someone is knocking at the door.

title: Expressing "mistakenly think that" with "yiwei"
structure: Subj. + 以为……
explanation: “以为”表示“本来以为（但错了）”。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi tā shì Déguórén.
examples.en: I thought he was German.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yǐwéi nǐ bù zài jiā.
examples.en: We thought you weren't at home.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǐwéi nǐ shì shéi?
examples.en: Who do you think you are?

examples.zh: 不要以为他是你的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Bùyào yǐwéi tā shì nǐ de péngyou.
examples.en: Don't think that he's your friend.

title: Expressing "through" with "jingguo"
structure: 经过 + Event/Time，……
explanation: “经过”表示“经过、通过（过程）”，可作动词“路过”，也可作介词。

examples.zh: 我每天上班都经过这里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shàngbān dōu jīngguò zhèlǐ.
examples.en: I pass by this place every day on the way to work.

examples.zh: 经过自己的努力，她考上了北京大学。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò zìjǐ de nǔlì, tā kǎoshàng le Běijīng Dàxué.
examples.en: Through her own hard work, she was admitted into Peking University.

examples.zh: 经过两个月的准备，他顺利地通过了这次面试。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò liǎng gè yuè de zhǔnbèi, tā shùnlì de tōngguò le zhè cì miànshì.
examples.en: After two months of preparation, he successfully passed the job interview.

examples.zh: 经过一个星期的调查，警察认为他没有罪。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò yī gè xīngqī de diàochá, jǐngchá rènwéi tā méiyǒu zuì.
examples.en: After one week of investigation, the police believe that he's not guilty.

title: Expressing "through" with "tongguo"
structure: 通过 + Agent/Method，Subj. ……
explanation: “通过”表示“通过、经过”，可作动词“通过（考试）”，也可作介词“通过（方法）”。

examples.zh: 从我家到那儿要通过两座桥。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào nàr yào tōngguò liǎng zuò qiáo.
examples.en: To get there from my house, you have to cross two bridges.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ tōngguò le zhège kǎoshì.
examples.en: I passed this test.

examples.zh: 我们是通过他的朋友找到他的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shì tōngguò tā de péngyou zhǎodào tā de.
examples.en: We found him via his friends.

examples.zh: 通过这个调查，我们发现很多人都支持他。
examples.pinyin: Tōngguò zhège diàochá, wǒmen fāxiàn hěn duō rén dōu zhīchí tā.
examples.en: Through this survey, we found that many people support him.

similar: Using "lai" to connect two verb phrases (B1)

title: Expressing "to come from" with "laizi"
structure: Subj. + 来自 + Place
explanation: “来自”表示“来自……”。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ láizì Zhōngguó.
examples.en: I come from China.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shū dōu láizì Rìběn.
examples.en: These books all come from Japan.

examples.zh: 我的这个想法来自生活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de zhège xiǎngfǎ láizì shēnghuó.
examples.en: This idea of mine originated from daily life.

examples.zh: 小明的成功来自他的努力和认真。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Míng de chénggōng láizì tā de nǔlì hé rènzhēn.
examples.en: Xiao Ming's success stems from his hard work and earnestness.

title: Making judgments with "suan"
structure: Subj. (+ 不) + 算 + Noun；Subj. + 算 + Adj. + 的；Subj. + 不 + 算 + Adj.
explanation: “算”表示“算作、算是”，可接名词或形容词；否定“不算”。

examples.pinyin: Tā suàn tiāncái.
examples.en: She is considered a genius.

examples.pinyin: Zhè suàn mìmì ma?
examples.en: Is this considered a secret?

examples.zh: 我们认识，但是不算朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen rènshi, dànshì bù suàn péngyou.
examples.en: We know each other, but can't be considered friends.

examples.zh: 这家店的东西算便宜的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de dōngxi suàn piányi de.
examples.en: The things in this shop are pretty cheap.

examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì bù suàn nán.
examples.en: This exam isn't that difficult.

title: Using "lai" as a dummy verb
structure: (让 +) Subj. + 来
explanation: “来”作代动词，表示“让我来/你来做”，替代具体动作。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái!
examples.en: You do it!

examples.pinyin: Wǒ lái ba.
examples.en: Let me do it.

examples.pinyin: Ràng tā zìjǐ lái.
examples.en: Let him do it himself.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiě de hǎokàn, nǐ lái ba.
examples.en: You write well. You write it.

title: Expressing "don't need to" with "buyong"
structure: Subj. + 不用 + [Verb Phrase]
explanation: “不用”表示“不需要、不必”。

examples.pinyin: Bùyòng xiè.
examples.en: You don't need to thank me.

examples.pinyin: Bùyòng dānxīn.
examples.en: You don't need to worry.

examples.pinyin: Háizi bùyòng mǎi piào.
examples.en: Kids don't need to buy tickets.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān bùyòng jiābān.
examples.en: We don't need to work overtime today.

similar: Auxiliary verb "yao" and its multiple meanings (A2)

title: Expressing "must" with "dei"
structure: Subj. + 得 (děi) + [Verb Phrase]
explanation: “得 (děi)”表示“必须、得”。

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen děi zǒu le.
examples.en: We have to leave now.

examples.zh: 时间不早了，我得回家了。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān bù zǎo le, wǒ děi huíjiā le.
examples.en: It's getting late. I have to go home.

examples.pinyin: Tā shì nǐ dìdi, nǐ děi bāng tā.
examples.en: He is your younger brother. You must help him.

examples.zh: 在学校就得听老师的话。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuéxiào jiù děi tīng lǎoshī de huà.
examples.en: You have to listen to the teacher at school.

title: Doing something less with "shao"
structure: 少 + Verb
explanation: “少 + 动词”表示“少做某事”。

examples.pinyin: Qǐng shǎo fàng diǎn yán.
examples.en: Use less salt, please.

examples.pinyin: Shǎo chī lājī shípǐn.
examples.en: Eat less junk food.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bu néng shǎo chōu diǎn yān?
examples.en: Can you smoke less?

examples.zh: 少喝点，明天还要上班呢。
examples.pinyin: Shǎo hē diǎn, míngtiān hái yào shàngbān ne.
examples.en: Don't drink so much. You need go to work tomorrow.

title: Doing something more with "duo"
structure: 多 + Verb
explanation: “多 + 动词”表示“多做某事”。

examples.pinyin: Duō chī diǎn.
examples.en: Eat a little more.

examples.pinyin: Duō fàng diǎn là.
examples.en: Add a little more spiciness.

examples.pinyin: Yéye, nǐ yào duō chūqù zǒuzou.
examples.en: Gramps, you need to go out and take walks more often.

examples.pinyin: Gǎnmào de shíhou yào duō hē shuǐ.
examples.en: Drink more water when you have a cold.

title: Expressing "not often" with "bu zenme"
structure: Subj. + 不怎么 + Verb
explanation: “不怎么 + 动词”表示“不常做某事”，也可表示数量少。

examples.pinyin: Tā bù zěnme ài shuōhuà.
examples.en: He doesn't like to talk much.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ lǎogōng bù zěnme yùndòng.
examples.en: My husband doesn't exercise much.

examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn bù zěnme lái bàngōngshì.
examples.en: My boss doesn't come to the office very often.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi zěnme fùxí.
examples.en: I didn't review much.

title: Expressing "until" with "dao"
structure: Verb (+ 一直) + 到 + Time/Event；[Verb Phrase] (+ 一直) + Verb + 到 + Time/Event
explanation: “到”放在动词后表示“直到……”。

examples.pinyin: Nǐmen yào wán dào jǐ diǎn?
examples.en: When will you be done playing?

examples.zh: 我们在酒吧一直聊到半夜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài jiǔbā yīzhí liáo dào bànyè.
examples.en: We were chatting in the bar until midnight.

examples.zh: 我女儿昨天晚上写作业写到十二点半。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǚ'ér zuótiān wǎnshang xiě zuòyè xiě dào shí'èr diǎn bàn.
examples.en: My daughter didn't finish her homework until 12:30 last night.

examples.zh: 她给男朋友打电话打到手机没电。
examples.pinyin: Tā gěi nánpéngyou dǎ diànhuà dǎ dào shǒujī méi diàn.
examples.en: She called her boyfriend and they kept talking until her phone was out of battery.

title: Expressing actions in progress (full form)
structure: Subj. + 正在/正/在 + Verb + 呢；Subj. (+ 正) + Verb + 着 + Obj. + 呢
explanation: 完整进行式“正在……呢”，各部分常省略，最常见是“在 + V”或“正 + V”。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhèngzài chīfàn.
examples.en: I'm eating now.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng chī zhe fàn ne.
examples.en: I'm eating now.

examples.zh: 爷爷正在看报纸，别打扰他。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zhèngzài kàn bàozhǐ, bié dǎrǎo tā.
examples.en: Grandpa is reading newspapers now. Don't disturb him.

examples.zh: 老板在开会，不方便接电话。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn zài kāihuì, bù fāngbiàn jiē diànhuà.
examples.en: The boss is in the middle of a meeting. It's not convenient for him to talk on the phone.

title: Measure words for verbs
structure: Verb + Number + Measure Word
explanation: 动量词“次、遍、下”表示动作次数。

examples.pinyin: Zài shuō yī biàn.
examples.en: Say it again.

examples.pinyin: Zhège diànyǐng wǒ kàn guo liǎng biàn.
examples.en: I've seen this movie twice.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù guo liǎng cì.
examples.en: We've been there twice.

examples.zh: 那个红头发的男孩打了我三下。
examples.pinyin: Nàge hóng tóufa de nánhái dǎ le wǒ sān xià.
examples.en: That red-haired boy hit me three times.

title: Separable verbs
structure: Verb + Object；Verb... [Other Stuff]... Object
explanation: 离合词（动宾短语）可分开，如“见面、睡觉、吃饭”；宾语不能直接加在离合词后。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān jiànmiàn.
examples.en: I don't have time to meet.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān jiàn nǐ.
examples.en: I don't have time to meet you.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zuótiān jiàn le miàn.
examples.en: We met yesterday.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiàn gè miàn ba.
examples.en: Let's meet.

examples.pinyin: Wǎn'ān! Shuì gè hǎo jiào.
examples.en: Good night! I hope you have a good sleep.

title: Verbs followed by "gei"
structure: Subj. + Verb + 给 + Recipient + Obj.；Subj. + 把 + Obj. + Verb + 给 + Recipient
explanation: “动词 + 给 + 人”表示“把……给某人”，动词多为单音节。

examples.zh: 昨天有人送给我一束花。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān yǒu rén sòng gěi wǒ yī shù huā.
examples.en: Yesterday someone gave me a bouquet of flowers.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng dì gěi wǒ yī hé zhǐjīn.
examples.en: Please pass me a box of tissues.

examples.zh: 你想把这个礼物送给谁？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng bǎ zhège lǐwù sòng gěi shéi?
examples.en: Who are you going to give this present to?

examples.zh: 她已经把车卖给了一个朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng bǎ chē mài gěi le yī gè péngyou.
examples.en: I've already sold my car to a friend of mine.

title: Verbs preceded by "gei"
structure: Subj. + 给 + Target + [Verb Phrase]
explanation: “给 + 对象 + 动词”表示“为/向/给某人做某事”。

examples.pinyin: Xiànzài bùyào gěi tā dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: Don't give him a phone call now.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng kuàidiǎn gěi wǒ huí yóujiàn.
examples.en: Please hurry up and reply to my email.

examples.zh: 你可以给大家读一下吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ gěi dàjiā dú yīxià ma?
examples.en: Could you please read it for everybody?

examples.pinyin: Bàba yīnggāi gěi érzi dàoqiàn.
examples.en: The father should apologize to his son.

title: Degree complement
structure: Verb + 得 + [Degree Complement]；Adj. + 极了/死了/坏了
explanation: 程度补语表示动作或形容词的程度，常用“得”。形容词后可直接加“极了/死了/坏了”。

examples.pinyin: Nǐmen juéde wǒ huà de zěnmeyàng?
examples.en: How well do you think I draw?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen juéde nǐ huà de hěn hǎo.
examples.en: We think you draw very well.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō Zhōngwén shuō de hěn hǎo.
examples.en: You speak Chinese well.

examples.pinyin: Wèidào hǎo jíle.
examples.en: The taste is amazing.

examples.pinyin: Tā de wàzi chòu sǐle.
examples.en: His socks totally reek.

title: Direction complement
structure: Verb + 来/去；Verb + [Compound Direction Complement]；Verb + Object + Complement
explanation: 趋向补语表示动作方向，用“来/去”及复合趋向补语（上来、下去、出来等）。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài lóushàng, nǐ shànglái.
examples.en: I'm on the upper floor. Come up to me.

examples.zh: 出来玩吧，我们在酒吧等你。
examples.pinyin: Chūlái wán ba, wǒmen zài jiǔbā děng nǐ.
examples.en: Come and hang out with us. We'll be waiting in the bar.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng zhàn qǐlái.
examples.en: Please stand up.

examples.zh: 服务员，请再拿几个碗来。
examples.pinyin: Fúwùyuán, qǐng zài ná jǐ gè wǎn lái.
examples.en: Waiter, please bring a few more bowls.

title: Direction complement "-qilai"
structure: Verb + 起来；Verb/Adj. + 起来 + 了；Subj. + Verb + 起来 + Adv. + Adj.
explanation: “起来”可表示向上、动作开始、初步判断（看起来/听起来……）。

examples.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā zhàn qǐlái.
examples.en: Everyone, please stand up.

examples.pinyin: Xiǎoniǎo fēi qǐlái le.
examples.en: The birds started flying.

examples.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái hěn yǒuhǎo.
examples.en: He looks very friendly.

examples.zh: 这件衣服听起来有点复杂。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu tīng qǐlái yǒudiǎn fùzá.
examples.en: This matter sounds a little bit complex.

title: Potential complement
structure: Subj. + Verb + 得 + Complement；Subj. + Verb + 不 + Complement
explanation: 可能补语表示能否做到，肯定“V得……”，否定“V不……”。

examples.zh: 你没戴眼镜，看得清楚吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ méi dài yǎnjìng, kàn de qīngchu ma?
examples.en: You didn't wear glasses. Can you see clearly?

examples.pinyin: Tā zhème cūxīn, zuò de hǎo ma?
examples.en: He's so careless. Can he do it well?

examples.zh: 你的声音太小了，我们听不见。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de shēngyīn tài xiǎo le, wǒmen tīng bu jiàn.
examples.en: Your voice is too soft. We can't hear you.

examples.zh: 包太小了，手机放不进去。
examples.pinyin: Bāo tài xiǎo le, shǒujī fàng bu jìnqù.
examples.en: The bag is too small. I can't fit the cell phone in it.

similar: Potential complement "-bu dong" for not understanding (A2)

title: Result complement "-xiaqu"
structure: Subj. + Verb + 下去；Subj. + Verb + 不 + 下去 (+ 了)
explanation: “下去”表示继续下去；否定“V不下去”表示无法继续。

examples.pinyin: Shuō xiàqù.
examples.en: Keep talking.

examples.zh: 这本书你一定要认真地看下去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū nǐ yīdìng yào rènzhēn de kàn xiàqù.
examples.en: You must keep reading this book carefully.

examples.zh: 这个电影太暴力了，我看不下去了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège diànyǐng tài bàolì le, wǒ kàn bu xiàqù le.
examples.en: This movie is too violent. I can't keep watching it.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài hē xiàqù jiù zuì le.
examples.en: If you keep drinking you're going to get drunk.

title: Result complements
structure: Subj. + Verb + Adj. + 了 (+ Obj.)；Subj. + 没 + Verb + Adj. (+ Obj.)；Subj. + Verb + [One-syllable Verb] + 了 (+ Obj.)
explanation: 结果补语表示动作结果，常用形容词或单音节动词（好、错、完、到、见、懂等）。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ chī hǎo le ma?
examples.en: Are you done eating?

examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ jì cuò le shíjiān.
examples.en: Sorry, I misremembered the time.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ cǎi dào le wǒ de jiǎo.
examples.en: You're stepping on my foot.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī ná zǒu le wǒ de iPad.
examples.en: The teacher took away my iPad.

similar: Expressing not knowing how to do something using "hao" (B1)

title: Expressing "all" with "suoyou"
structure: 所有 (+ 的) + Noun；所有 (+ 的) + Noun + 都 + Predicate；不是 + 所有 (+ 的) + Noun + 都 + Predicate
explanation: “所有”表示“所有、全部”，谓语常用“都”；否定“不是所有……都……”表示“不是全部”。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ mǎi le tā suǒyǒu de shū?
examples.en: You've bought all her books?

examples.pinyin: Suǒyǒu rén dōu zǒu le ma?
examples.en: Did all the people leave?

examples.zh: 不是所有的美国人都爱喝咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Bù shì suǒyǒu de Měiguórén dōu ài hē kāfēi.
examples.en: Not all Americans like drinking coffee.

examples.zh: 不是所有问题都能用钱来解决。
examples.pinyin: Bù shì suǒyǒu wèntí dōu néng yòng qián lái jiějué.
examples.en: Not all problems can be solved with money.

title: Expressing "one of" with "zhiyi"
structure: Subj. + 是 + [Noun Phrase] + 之一；[Noun Phrase] + 之一 + 是……
explanation: “之一”表示“……之一”，常与“最”搭配。

examples.zh: 她是我最好的朋友之一。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyou zhī yī.
examples.en: She is one of my best friends.

examples.zh: Frozen是我最喜欢的迪斯尼电影之一。
examples.pinyin: Frozen shì wǒ zuì xǐhuan de Dísīní diànyǐng zhī yī.
examples.en: Frozen is one of my favorite Disney movies.

examples.zh: 纽约是世界上最国际化的城市之一。
examples.pinyin: Niǔyuē shì shìjiè shàng zuì guójìhuà de chéngshì zhī yī.
examples.en: New York is one of the most international cities in the world.

examples.zh: 他是这个公司的创始人之一。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì zhège gōngsī de chuàngshǐrén zhī yī.
examples.en: He is one of the founders of this company.

title: Expressing "the other" with "lingwai"
structure: 另外 + Number + [Measure Word] + Noun；另 + 一个
explanation: “另外”表示“另外的、其他的”，后可接数量词。

examples.zh: 我有两个手机，一个是小米，另一个是iPhone。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng gè shǒujī, yī gè shì Xiǎomǐ, lìng yī gè shì iPhone.
examples.en: I have two cell phones. One is a Xiaomi, and the other is an iPhone.

examples.zh: 她有两套房子，一套自己住，另一套租给别人了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu liǎng tào fángzi, yī tào zìjǐ zhù, lìng yī tào zū gěi biérén le.
examples.en: She has two houses. She lives in one and rents the other one to other people.

examples.zh: 我买了三张票，一张是我的，另外两张是给朋友的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le sān zhāng piào, yī zhāng shì wǒ de, lìngwài liǎng zhāng shì gěi péngyou de.
examples.en: I bought three tickets. One is for myself, and the other two are for my friends.

examples.zh: 这个蛋糕一半是你的，另一半是妹妹的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dàngāo yībàn shì nǐ de, lìng yībàn shì mèimei de.
examples.en: Half of this cake is yours. The other half is your little sister's.

title: The "shi... de" construction for emphasizing details
structure: Subj. + 是 + [Information to be Emphasized] + Verb + 的
explanation: “是……的”强调过去事件的细节（时间、地点、方式等），不是单纯表示过去。

examples.pinyin: Nǐmen shì shénme shíhou dào de?
examples.en: When did you guys arrive?

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shì zuótiān dào de.
examples.en: We arrived yesterday.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì zài nǎr chūshēng de?
examples.en: Where were you born?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì zài Xiānggǎng chūshēng de.
examples.en: I was born in Hong Kong.

examples.zh: 我们不是在网上认识的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù shì zài wǎngshàng rènshi de.
examples.en: We didn't meet online.

similar: The "shi... de" construction for indicating purpose (B1)

title: The "shi... de" construction for indicating purpose
structure: Person + 是 + 来/去 + Verb + 的；Thing + 是 + 用来 + Verb + 的；Thing + 是 + 给 + Person + Verb + 的
explanation: “是……的”表示目的/用途：“是来做……的”“是用来……的”。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì lái wán de.
examples.en: I came for fun.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu shì qù chūchāi de.
examples.en: We are all going on business trips.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cài shì yònglái zuò tāng de.
examples.en: This kind of vegetable is for making soup.

examples.zh: 这个房间是给客人住的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān shì gěi kèrén zhù de.
examples.en: This room is for our guest to stay in.

similar: The "shi... de" construction for emphasizing details (B1)

title: Topic-comment sentences
structure: Topic，Comment
explanation: 主题句把要强调的成分放句首，后加评论。

examples.pinyin: Shuǐguǒ, wǒ zuì ài chī cǎoméi.
examples.en: Fruit, I like strawberries best.

examples.pinyin: Kāfēi, wǒ dōu hē wán le.
examples.en: I'm sorry. I finished all the coffee.

examples.zh: 这个问题，你一个人没办法解决。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí, nǐ yīgèrén méi bànfǎ jiějué.
examples.en: There is no way that you can solve this problem all by yourself.

examples.zh: 那部电影，看过的人都喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Nà bù diànyǐng, kàn guo de rén dōu xǐhuan.
examples.en: All the people that have watched that movie like it.

title: Using "ba" sentences
structure: Subj. + 把 + Obj. + [Verb Phrase]
explanation: “把”字句把宾语提前，强调对宾语的处置结果。宾语需定指，动词后需有其他成分。

examples.pinyin: Bǎ shū fàng zài zhuōzi shàng.
examples.en: Put the book on the table.

examples.zh: 她把我的手机放在她的包里了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ wǒ de shǒujī fàng zài tā de bāo lǐ le.
examples.en: She put my cell phone in her bag.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ zuòyè zuò wán le.
examples.en: I finished doing my homework.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ kèrén dài jìnqù.
examples.en: Please take the guests inside.

title: Using "bei" sentences
structure: Subj. + 被 (+ Doer) + Verb + 了
explanation: “被”字句表示被动，动词后需有“了/补语”等成分，常带不如意语气。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bèi tā piàn le.
examples.en: I was deceived by him.

examples.pinyin: Tā bèi jǐngchá zhuā le.
examples.en: He was caught by the police.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de chē bèi zhuàng le.
examples.en: My car was hit.

examples.pinyin: Kāfēi bèi wǒ hē wán le.
examples.en: The coffee was finished by me.

title: Alternative existential sentences
structure: Place + Verb + 着 + [Noun Phrase]；Place + 是 + [Noun Phrase]
explanation: “处所 + 动词 + 着 + 名词”表示某处存在某物；“处所 + 是 + 名词”强调某处只有某物。

examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng fàng zhe yī běn shū.
examples.en: There is a book on the desk.

examples.pinyin: Dàtīng lǐ zhàn zhe yīxiē jǐngchá.
examples.en: There are several policemen standing in the hall.

examples.zh: 洗衣机里是一些脏衣服。
examples.pinyin: Xǐyījī lǐ shì yīxiē zāng yīfu.
examples.en: There are dirty clothes inside the washing machine.

examples.pinyin: Hézi lǐ shì nǐ de lǐwù.
examples.en: Your gift is in the box.

title: Expressing "as one likes" with "xiang... jiu..."
structure: 想 + Verb + 就 + Verb；想 + Verb + [Question Word] + 就 + Verb + [Question Word]
explanation: “想V就V”表示“想怎样就怎样”；加疑问词表示“想……就……”。

examples.pinyin: Xiǎng chī jiù chī.
examples.en: If you want to eat, help yourself.

examples.pinyin: Xiǎng zǒu jiù zǒu ba.
examples.en: Leave if you want to.

examples.pinyin: Xiǎng qù nǎr jiù qù nǎr.
examples.en: You can go wherever you'd like to go.

examples.pinyin: Xiǎng qǐng shéi jiù qǐng shéi.
examples.en: You can invite whoever you like.

title: Expressing "double negation"
structure: Subj. + 不是 + 不/没 + Predicate；Subj. + 不 + 会/能/可能 + 不/没 + Predicate；没有 + [Singular Noun] + 不/没 + Predicate + 的
explanation: 双重否定表示强调肯定。

examples.pinyin: Tā bù huì bù lái de.
examples.en: There is no way he's not coming.

examples.pinyin: Tā bù kěnéng bù zhīdào.
examples.en: There is no way she doesn't know about this.

examples.zh: 没有一个人不讨厌他的。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu yī gè rén bù tǎoyàn tā de.
examples.en: There is not one person who doesn't dislike him.

examples.zh: 这些菜没有一个是辣的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē cài méiyǒu yī gè shì là de.
examples.en: There is no single one that is not spicy among these dishes.

title: Expressing "even" with "lian" and "dou"
structure: 连 + Subj./Obj. + 都 (+ 不/没) + Verb
explanation: “连……都……”表示“连……都……”，强调意外。

examples.zh: 这个问题太简单了，连三岁小孩都知道。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí tài jiǎndān le, lián sān suì xiǎohái dōu zhīdào.
examples.en: This question is so easy that even a three-year-old kid knows the answer.

examples.zh: 这个汉字太难了，连我的中文老师都不认识。
examples.pinyin: Zhège Hànzì tài nán le, lián wǒ de Zhōngwén lǎoshī dōu bù rènshi.
examples.en: This Chinese character is so difficult that even my Chinese teacher doesn't know it.

examples.zh: 他什么都吃，连狗肉都吃。
examples.pinyin: Tā shénme dōu chī, lián gǒu ròu dōu chī.
examples.en: He eats everything, even dog meat.

examples.zh: 你连你最好的朋友都不相信？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lián nǐ zuìhǎo de péngyou dōu bù xiāngxìn?
examples.en: You don't even trust your best friend?

title: Expressing "every time" with "mei" and "dou"
structure: 每次 + Event 1 + 都 + Event 2

examples.pinyin: Tā měi cì lái wǒ jiā dōu dài huā.
examples.en: She brings flowers every time she visits me.

examples.zh: 为什么每次我来他都不在？
examples.pinyin: Wèishénme měi cì wǒ lái tā dōu bù zài?
examples.en: How come he's not here every time I come?

examples.zh: 我每次玩这个游戏都输。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì wán zhège yóuxì dōu shū.
examples.en: Every time I play this game, I lose.

examples.zh: 他每次迟到都说因为堵车。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi cì chídào dōu shuō yīnwèi dǔchē.
examples.en: Every time he's late, he says it's because of bad traffic.

title: Expressing "every" with question words
structure: 谁/哪儿/什么时候/多少/怎么 + 都 + Predicate
explanation: 疑问词 + 都 表示“任何……都/都……”。

examples.pinyin: Shéi dōu xǐhuan měishí.
examples.en: Everyone likes delicious food.

examples.zh: 他的房间里哪儿都是脏衣服。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fángjiān lǐ nǎr dōu shì zāng yīfu.
examples.en: His dirty laundry is all over his room.

examples.pinyin: Shénme shíhou dōu kěyǐ.
examples.en: Anytime is fine.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng chī duōshao dōu kěyǐ.
examples.en: You can eat however much you want.

title: Expressing "how often"
structure: Subj. + 多长时间 + Verb + 一次 (+ Obj.)；Subj. + [Length of Time] + Verb + Times (+ Obj.)
explanation: “多长时间……一次”询问频率；“一段时间 + 动词 + 次数”表示频率。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ duō cháng shíjiān tī yī cì qiú?
examples.en: How often do you play soccer?

examples.zh: 你多长时间剪一次头发？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ duō cháng shíjiān jiǎn yī cì tóufa?
examples.en: How often do you cut your hair?

examples.zh: 我一周给妈妈打两次电话。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yī zhōu gěi māma dǎ liǎng cì diànhuà.
examples.en: I give mom a call twice a week.

examples.zh: 这种药四个小时吃一次。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào sì gè xiǎoshí chī yī cì.
examples.en: Take this medicine every four hours.

title: Expressing "more and more" with "yuelaiyue"
structure: Subj. + 越来越 + Adj./Verb + 了
explanation: “越来越……”表示“越来越……”。

examples.pinyin: Tiānqì yuèláiyuè lěng le.
examples.en: The weather is getting colder and colder.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ nǚ'ér yuèláiyuè piàoliang le.
examples.en: Your daughter is getting more and more beautiful.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yuèláiyuè xǐhuan Shànghǎi le.
examples.en: I like Shanghai more and more.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yuèláiyuè bù xiāngxìn tā le.
examples.en: I believe him less and less.

similar: Expressing "the more... the more..." with "yue... yue..." (B2)

title: Expressing "multiples" with "bei"
structure: A + 是 + B + 的 + Number + 倍；A + 比 + B + Adj. + Number + 倍
explanation: “倍”表示倍数；“A是B的几倍”表示A是B的几倍；“A比B + 形容词 + 几倍”表示多几倍。

examples.zh: 他现在的工资是两年前的四倍。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiànzài de gōngzī shì liǎng nián qián de sì bèi.
examples.en: His current salary is four times what it was two years ago.

examples.zh: 今年的产量是去年的两倍。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de chǎnliàng shì qùnián de liǎng bèi.
examples.en: This year's output is twice as much as last year's.

examples.zh: 我家客厅比你家客厅大一倍。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā kètīng bǐ nǐ jiā kètīng dà yī bèi.
examples.en: My home's living room is double the size of your home's living room.

examples.zh: 他的车比你的车贵十倍。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chē bǐ nǐ de chē guì shí bèi.
examples.en: His car is 11 times more expensive than your car.

title: Expressing "not at all" with "yidianr ye bu"
structure: Subj. + 一点(儿) + 也/都 + 不 + Adj./Verb Phrase；一点也没/都没 + Verb Phrase
explanation: “一点也不/都不……”表示“一点也不……”；“一点也没/都没……”用于过去否定。

examples.zh: 那个问题一点儿也不难。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wèntí yīdiǎnr yě bù nán.
examples.en: That question isn't difficult at all.

examples.pinyin: Zhège cài yīdiǎn dōu bù hǎochī.
examples.en: This dish isn't tasty at all.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yīdiǎn yě bù xǐhuan nǎilào.
examples.en: I don't like cheese at all.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yīdiǎn yě méi shēngqì.
examples.en: I wasn't angry at all.

title: Expressing "some" with question words
structure: 哪儿/谁/什么/什么时候
explanation: 疑问词可表示不确定的“某处/某人/某物/某时”。

examples.pinyin: Zhège rén wǒ zài nǎr jiàn guo.
examples.en: I've met this person somewhere before.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ ràng shéi lái bāng wǒ yīxià.
examples.en: Ask someone to help me with this.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi zuò diǎnr shénme.
examples.en: We should do something.

examples.zh: 什么时候我们见面谈吧。
examples.pinyin: Shénme shíhou wǒmen jiànmiàn tán ba.
examples.en: Let's meet and talk about this sometime.

title: Expressing not knowing how to do something using "hao"
structure: Subj. + 不知道 + [Verb Phrase] + 好
explanation: “不知道……好”表示“不知道……才好”，强调为难。

examples.zh: 我真的不知道怎么办才好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhēnde bù zhīdào zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.en: I really don't know what to do about this.

examples.zh: 我们都不知道说什么好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu bù zhīdào shuō shénme hǎo.
examples.en: None of us knew what to say.

examples.zh: 这件事我不知道跟谁说好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ bù zhīdào gēn shéi shuō hǎo.
examples.en: I'm not sure who to talk to about this matter.

examples.zh: 这些钱他不知道放在哪儿才好。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē qián tā bù zhīdào fàng zài nǎr cái hǎo.
examples.en: He doesn't know where to put this money.

title: Expressing purpose with "weile"
structure: 为了……，Subj. ……；……是 + 为了/因为……
explanation: “为了”表示目的“为了……”；也可“是 + 为了”说明原因/目的。

examples.zh: 为了钱，他什么都愿意做。
examples.pinyin: Wèile qián, tā shénme dōu yuànyì zuò.
examples.en: He's willing to do anything for money.

examples.zh: 为了孩子的未来，他决定搬到上海。
examples.pinyin: Wèile háizi de wèilái, tā juédìng bāndào Shànghǎi.
examples.en: He decided to move to Shanghai for his children's future.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhème zuò shì wèile bāng nǐ.
examples.en: I did all this to help you.

examples.zh: 他做兼职是为了多赚点钱。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò jiānzhí shì wèile duō zhuàn diǎn qián.
examples.en: The reason why he has a part time job is to make a little more money.

similar: Using "lai" to connect two verb phrases (B1)

title: Phrases using "laishuo"
structure: 对 + Person + 来说，……；Word + 来说
explanation: “对……来说”表示“对……来说”；“一般来说/总的来说/相对来说/严格来说/具体来说”为固定短语。

examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, Zhōngwén bù róngyì.
examples.en: For me, Chinese is not easy.

examples.zh: 一般来说，私立学校都比较贵。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, sīlì xuéxiào dōu bǐjiào guì.
examples.en: Ordinarily, private schools are more expensive.

examples.zh: 总的来说，这次活动很成功。
examples.pinyin: Zǒng de lái shuō, zhè cì huódòng hěn chénggōng.
examples.en: In general, this event was a success.

examples.zh: 严格来说，他是华裔，不是中国人。
examples.pinyin: Yángé lái shuō, tā shì huáyì, bù shì Zhōngguórén.
examples.en: Technically, he is ethnically Chinese, not a Chinese citizen.

title: Expressing "compared with" using "gen"
structure: 跟 + A + 比(起来)，B……；B + 跟 + A + 比(起来)，……
explanation: “跟A比(起来)，B……”表示“跟A相比，B……”。

examples.zh: 跟上海比，我老家的物价很低。
examples.pinyin: Gēn Shànghǎi bǐ, wǒ lǎojiā de wùjià hěn dī.
examples.en: Compared to Shanghai, prices in my hometown are very low.

examples.zh: 跟他比，你最大的优势是什么？
examples.pinyin: Gēn tā bǐ, nǐ zuì dà de yōushì shì shénme?
examples.en: Compared to him, what is your biggest advantage?

examples.zh: 跟去年比，你的中文进步了很多。
examples.pinyin: Gēn qùnián bǐ, nǐ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le hěn duō.
examples.en: Compared to last year, your Chinese has improved a lot.

examples.zh: 跟十年前比起来，中国人的生活水平提高了很多。
examples.pinyin: Gēn shí nián qián bǐ qǐlái, Zhōngguórén de shēnghuó shuǐpíng tígāo le hěn duō.
examples.en: Compared to ten years ago, the standard of living for Chinese people has gotten much better.

title: Expressing "even more" with "geng" or "hai"
structure: Noun 1 + 比 + Noun 2 + 更/还 + Adj.
explanation: 比较句中“更/还 + 形容词”表示“更……/甚至更……”。

examples.pinyin: Shànghǎi bǐ Niǔyuē rénkǒu gèng duō.
examples.en: Shanghai's population is even bigger than New York's.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei bǐ wǒ gèng shòu.
examples.en: My younger sister is even skinnier than me.

examples.pinyin: Tā bǐ Yáo Míng hái gāo.
examples.en: He is even taller than Yao Ming.

examples.zh: 这个外国人的汉语说得比中国人还地道。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wàiguórén de Hànyǔ shuō de bǐ Zhōngguórén hái dìdao.
examples.en: This foreigner speaks even more authentic Chinese than native speakers do.

title: Expressing "much more" in comparisons
structure: Noun 1 + 比 + Noun 2 + Adj. + 很多/得多/多了；Subj. + Adj. + 多了
explanation: “比…… + 很多/得多/多了”表示“比……得多”。

examples.pinyin: Pīnyīn bǐ Hànzì róngyì hěn duō.
examples.en: Pinyin is much easier than Chinese characters.

examples.zh: 这个女老师比那个男老师严格得多。
examples.pinyin: Zhège nǚ lǎoshī bǐ nàge nán lǎoshī yángé de duō.
examples.en: This female teacher is much stricter than that male teacher.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǐ wǒ yǒu jīngyàn duō le.
examples.en: You're much more experienced than me.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de gǎnmào hǎo duō le.
examples.en: My cold is getting much better.

title: Expressing comparable degree with "you"
structure: A + 有 + B + Adj. + 吗？；A + 有 + B + Verb + 得 + Adj. + 吗？；A + 有 (+ B) + 这么/那么 + Adj. + 吗？
explanation: “A有B + 形容词 + 吗？”表示“A有B那么……吗？”多用于疑问。

examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu wǒ shuài ma?
examples.en: Is he as handsome as me?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu lǎobǎn máng ma?
examples.en: Are you as busy as the boss?

examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu wǒ zuò de hǎo ma?
examples.en: Can he do it as well as I do?

examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu nàme piàoliang ma?
examples.en: Is she really that pretty?

title: Conceding a point with "shi"
structure: Adj. + 是 + Adj.，但是/就是……
explanation: “A是A，但是/就是……”表示让步“虽然A，但是……”。

examples.zh: 工作忙是忙，但是我很开心。
examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò máng shì máng, dànshì wǒ hěn kāixīn.
examples.en: Work may be busy, but I'm very happy.

examples.zh: 这件衣服好看是好看，但是不适合我。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu hǎokàn shì hǎokàn, dànshì bù shìhé wǒ.
examples.en: This piece of clothing may look nice, but it doesn't suit me.

examples.pinyin: Lèi shì lèi, dànshì hěn zhídé.
examples.en: It may be tiring, but it's really worth it.

examples.zh: 好吃是好吃，就是不太健康。
examples.pinyin: Hǎochī shì hǎochī, jiùshì bù tài jiànkāng.
examples.en: It may be tasty, it's just that it's not very healthy.
