title: Events in quick succession with "yi... jiu..."
structure: 一 + Event 1，就 + Event 2；一 + Reason，就 + Result

examples.zh: 饿死了，我一下课就要去吃午饭。
examples.pinyin: È sǐ le, wǒ yī xiàkè jiù yào qù chī wǔfàn.
examples.en: I'm starving. I'm going to have lunch as soon as class is over.

examples.zh: 妈妈一到家就去做饭了。
examples.pinyin: Māma yī dào jiā jiù qù zuòfàn le.
examples.en: As soon as mom arrived home, she went off to cook.

examples.zh: 我一想到这件事就不高兴。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yī xiǎngdào zhè jiàn shì jiù bù gāoxìng.
examples.en: Every time I think about this, I get upset.

examples.pinyin: Tā yī shēngqì jiù liǎnhóng.
examples.en: Every time she gets angry, her face turns red.

title: Expressing "although" with "suiran" and "danshi"
structure: 虽然……，但是/可是……
explanation: “虽然……但是/可是……”表示“虽然……但是……”，中文必须成对使用。

examples.zh: 虽然外面很冷，可是里面很暖和。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán wàimiàn hěn lěng, kěshì lǐmiàn hěn nuǎnhuo.
examples.en: Although it's cold outside, it's warm inside.

examples.zh: 这件衣服虽然有点贵，但是质量很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu suīrán yǒudiǎn guì, dànshì zhìliàng hěn hǎo.
examples.en: Although this piece of clothing is a little expensive, the quality is good.

examples.zh: 他虽然不想去，但是还是去了。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán bù xiǎng qù, dànshì háishì qù le.
examples.en: Although he didn't want to go, he ended up going.

examples.zh: 奶奶虽然八十多岁了，但是她精神很好。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai suīrán bāshí duō suì le, dànshì tā jīngshén hěn hǎo.
examples.en: Although grandma is in her eighties, she is energetic.

title: Expressing "either... or..." with "yaome"
structure: 要么 + Option A，要么 + Option B
explanation: “要么……要么……”表示二选一。

examples.pinyin: Yàome nǐ qù, yàome tā qù.
examples.en: Either you go, or he goes.

examples.pinyin: Yàome jìxù, yàome fàngqì.
examples.en: Either keep going or give up.

examples.zh: 要么好好做，要么就别做。
examples.pinyin: Yàome hǎohǎo zuò, yàome jiù bié zuò.
examples.en: You either do it well or don't do it.

examples.zh: 你要么回老家，要么留在上海。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yàome huí lǎojiā, yàome liúzài Shànghǎi.
examples.en: You either go back to your hometown or stay in Shanghai.

title: Expressing "except" and "in addition" with "chule... yiwai"
structure: 除了……(以外)，Subj. + 都……；除了……(以外)，Subj. + 也/还……
explanation: “除了……都……”表示“除……之外都……”（排除）；“除了……也/还……”表示“除了……还……”（包含）。

examples.pinyin: Chúle tā, wǒmen dōu qù guo.
examples.en: Except for him, we've all been there.

examples.zh: 除了白酒，别的酒他都喝。
examples.pinyin: Chúle báijiǔ, biéde jiǔ tā dōu hē.
examples.en: He drinks all kinds of alcohol except baijiu.

examples.zh: 除了英语，我也会说法语和西班牙语。
examples.pinyin: Chúle Yīngyǔ, wǒ yě huì shuō Fǎyǔ hé Xībānyáyǔ.
examples.en: In addition to English, I can also speak French and Spanish.

examples.zh: 除了运动以外，你还有什么爱好？
examples.pinyin: Chúle yùndòng yǐwài, nǐ hái yǒu shénme àihào?
examples.en: In addition to sports, what other hobbies do you have?

title: Expressing "if" with "ruguo... dehua"
explanation: “如果……的话”表示“如果……的话”，口语可省略“如果”。

examples.zh: 如果明天下雨的话，我们就不去了。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān xiàyǔ dehuà, wǒmen jiù bù qù le.
examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

examples.zh: 别点那么多菜。如果吃不完的话，就太浪费了。
examples.pinyin: Bié diǎn nàme duō cài. Rúguǒ chī bu wán dehuà, jiù tài làngfèi le.
examples.en: Don't order so much. It will be a big waste of food if we can't finish it all.

examples.pinyin: Bù xiǎng qù dehuà jiù bié qù le.
examples.en: Don't go if you don't feel like going.

examples.pinyin: Hǎochī dehuà, jiù duō chī diǎn.
examples.en: If you think it's tasty, eat some more.

title: Expressing "if... then..." with "ruguo... jiu..."
structure: 如果……，就……；如果……，那么/那……

examples.zh: 如果有困难，就给我打电话。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu kùnnan, jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: If there is any difficulty, give me a call.

examples.zh: 如果你输了，就给我一百块。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ shū le, jiù gěi wǒ yībǎi kuài.
examples.en: If you lose, give me 100 kuai.

examples.zh: 如果他知道，那他一定会告诉我。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ tā zhīdào, nà tā yīdìng huì gàosu wǒ.
examples.en: If he knew, he would definitely tell me.

examples.zh: 如果能找到投资，那下个月就可以开始做了。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ néng zhǎodào tóuzī, nà xià gè yuè jiù kěyǐ kāishǐ zuò le.
examples.en: If we can find the investment, we'll be able to get on it next month.

title: Expressing "no wonder" with "guaibude"
structure: Reason，怪不得/难怪 + [Observation]；怪不得/难怪 + [Observation]，原来 (+ 是) + Reason
explanation: “怪不得/难怪”表示“难怪……”，表示明白原因后不觉得奇怪。

examples.zh: 小张请假了，怪不得今天没有看到他。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng qǐngjià le, guàibude jīntiān méiyǒu kàndào tā.
examples.en: Little Zhang asked for vacation time, no wonder I haven't seen him today.

examples.zh: 她是你妹妹？难怪你们长得这么像。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì nǐ mèimei? Nánguài nǐmen cháng de zhème xiàng.
examples.en: She's your younger sister? No wonder you two look so much alike.

examples.zh: 难怪学生都不喜欢这个老师，原来他的作业太多了。
examples.pinyin: Nánguài xuésheng dōu bù xǐhuan zhège lǎoshī, yuánlái tā de zuòyè tài duō le.
examples.en: No wonder the students don't like this teacher. He gives too much homework.

examples.zh: 怪不得你们这么高兴，原来是要结婚了。
examples.pinyin: Guàibude nǐmen zhème gāoxìng, yuánlái shì yào jiéhūn le.
examples.en: No wonder you two look so happy. You are getting married.

title: Expressing "not only... but also" with "budan... erqie..."
structure: Subj. + 不但……，而且……；不但 + Subj. 1……，而且 + Subj. 2 + 也……
explanation: “不但……而且……”表示“不但……而且……”。

examples.zh: 这个东西不但贵，而且难买。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dōngxi bùdàn guì, érqiě nán mǎi.
examples.en: This thing is not only expensive, but also hard to buy.

examples.zh: 她不但聪明，而且很幽默。
examples.pinyin: Tā bùdàn cōngming, érqiě hěn yōumò.
examples.en: She is not only smart, but also very humorous.

examples.zh: 不但大学生找工作难，而且研究生也不容易。
examples.pinyin: Bùdàn dàxuéshēng zhǎo gōngzuò nán, érqiě yánjiūshēng yě bù róngyì.
examples.en: Not only is it hard to find a job for undergraduates, but it's also hard for graduate students.

examples.zh: 这个电影不但孩子们喜欢，大人也很喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Zhège diànyǐng bùdàn háizimen xǐhuan, dàren yě hěn xǐhuan.
examples.en: Not only do children like this movie, but adults like it too.

similar: Using "budan... geng" to express "not only... but also" (B1)

title: Expressing "when" with "dengdao"
structure: 等(到) + Time/Event，Subj. + 再/就 + Predicate；等(到) + Time/Event，Subj. + 才 + Predicate
explanation: “等到……就/再……”表示将来“等到……就……”；“等到……才……”表示过去“直到……才……”。

examples.zh: 等到老板知道就麻烦了。
examples.pinyin: Děngdào lǎobǎn zhīdào jiù máfan le.
examples.en: When the boss finds out, we'll be in trouble.

examples.pinyin: Děng yǔ tíng le wǒ zài chūmén.
examples.en: When the rain stops, I'll go outside.

examples.zh: 等我回了家，才发现手机忘在了出租车上。
examples.pinyin: Děng wǒ huí le jiā, cái fāxiàn shǒujī wàng zài le chūzūchē shàng.
examples.en: I didn't realize I left my cell phone in the taxi until I got home.

examples.zh: 等到孩子上了小学，她才开始工作。
examples.pinyin: Děngdào háizi shàng le xiǎoxué, tā cái kāishǐ gōngzuò.
examples.en: She didn't start working until her children had started elementary school.

title: Expressing good luck with "haihao"
structure: 还好 + [Lucky Incident]，不然 + [Bad Outcome]
explanation: “还好……，不然……”表示“幸好……，否则……”。

examples.zh: 还好我们打车来的，不然就迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Háihǎo wǒmen dǎchē lái de, bùrán jiù chídào le.
examples.en: Luckily, we came by taxi. Otherwise we would have been late.

examples.zh: 还好我妈没看到，不然她肯定要生气。
examples.pinyin: Háihǎo wǒ mā méi kàndào, bùrán tā kěndìng yào shēngqì.
examples.en: It's a good thing that my mother didn't see it. Otherwise she would definitely be mad.

examples.zh: 还好有你在，不然我真不知道怎么办。
examples.pinyin: Háihǎo yǒu nǐ zài, bùrán wǒ zhēn bù zhīdào zěnme bàn.
examples.en: Fortunately you're here. Otherwise I really wouldn't have known what to do.

examples.zh: 还好带伞了，不然肯定淋湿了。
examples.pinyin: Háihǎo dài sǎn le, bùrán kěndìng línshī le.
examples.en: It's a good thing I brought the umbrella. Otherwise, I would have definitely gotten soaked.

title: Expressing various aspects with "yi fangmian"
structure: 一方面……，(另)一方面……
explanation: “一方面……(另)一方面……”表示“一方面……另一方面……”。

examples.zh: 自己做饭一方面健康，一方面还能省点钱。
examples.pinyin: Zìjǐ zuòfàn yī fāngmiàn jiànkāng, yī fāngmiàn hái néng shěng diǎn qián.
examples.en: On one hand, cooking for yourself is healthy; on the other hand, it can also help to save some money.

examples.zh: 他一方面想改变，一方面又害怕改变。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī fāngmiàn xiǎng gǎibiàn, yī fāngmiàn yòu hàipà gǎibiàn.
examples.en: On the one hand, he wants to change; on the other hand, he's afraid of change.

examples.zh: 用智能手机一方面很方便，另一方面也很容易浪费时间。
examples.pinyin: Yòng zhìnéng shǒujī yī fāngmiàn hěn fāngbiàn, lìng yī fāngmiàn yě hěn róngyì làngfèi shíjiān.
examples.en: On the one hand, using smart phones is very convenient; on the other hand, they also make it very easy to waste a lot of time.

examples.zh: 我们一方面要让客户满意，另一方面也要控制成本。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yī fāngmiàn yào ràng kèhù mǎnyì, lìng yī fāngmiàn yě yào kòngzhì chéngběn.
examples.en: On the one hand, we need to satisfy our clients, but on the other hand, we also need to control our costs.

title: Comparing "changchang" and "jingchang"
structure: 常常/经常 + Verb
explanation: “常常”和“经常”都表示“经常”，多数可互换；“经常”还可作形容词。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng shōudào lājī duǎnxìn.
examples.en: I often receive spam texts.

examples.pinyin: Nǐmen jīngcháng jiābān ma?
examples.en: Do you guys often work overtime?

examples.pinyin: Tāmen chángcháng chǎojià.
examples.en: They often argue.

examples.zh: 她忘带钥匙是经常的事情。
examples.pinyin: Tā wàng dài yàoshi shì jīngcháng de shìqing.
examples.en: It's a regular thing for her to forget to bring her keys.

title: Comparing "gang" and "gangcai"
structure: 刚 + Verb/Adj.；刚才 + Verb + 了
explanation: “刚”是副词，表示动作刚发生；“刚才”是时间名词，表示“刚才”，常与“了”连用。

examples.pinyin: Tā gāng dào.
examples.en: He just arrived.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zuótiān gāng dào.
examples.en: We just arrived yesterday.

examples.pinyin: Tā gāngcái kū le.
examples.en: He was crying just now.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái kàndào tā le.
examples.en: I just now saw him.

title: Comparing "youdian" and "yidian"
structure: 有点 + Adj.；Adj. + 一点；一点 + Noun
explanation: “有点”位于形容词前，常带抱怨；“一点”位于形容词后，表示程度/比较/请求，也可修饰名词。

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ yǒudiǎn lèi.
examples.en: I am a little tired today.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng shuō màn yīdiǎn.
examples.en: Please speak a little more slowly.

examples.pinyin: Zhège bǐ nàge zhòng yīdiǎn.
examples.en: This one is a bit heavier than that one.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ liǎn shàng yǒu yīdiǎn fānqiéjiàng.
examples.en: There's a little ketchup on your face.

similar: Expressing "not at all" with "yidianr ye bu" (B1)

title: Comparing "hui," "neng," "keyi"
structure: 会/能/可以 + Verb
explanation: “会”表示学会的技能；“能”表示能力/可能；“可以”表示许可。有交叉。

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu huì yóuyǒng.
examples.en: We all know how to swim.

examples.pinyin: Tā bù néng chī sān wǎn mǐfàn.
examples.en: He can't eat three bowls of rice.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, wǒ kěyǐ zǎo diǎn zǒu ma?
examples.en: Teacher, can I leave a little early?

examples.pinyin: Tā hěn huì shuōhuà.
examples.en: He's a smooth talker.

title: Comparing "haishi" and "huozhe"
structure: Option A + 还是 + Option B？（疑问）；Possibility 1 + 或者 + Possibility 2（陈述）
explanation: “还是”用于疑问句选择；“或者”用于陈述句选择。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan tā háishì wǒ?
examples.en: Do you like him or me?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ hē chá háishì hē kāfēi?
examples.en: Do you drink tea or coffee?

examples.zh: 周末我想在家看书或者看电影。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ xiǎng zài jiā kànshū huòzhě kàn diànyǐng.
examples.en: This weekend, I want to stay home and read or watch movies.

examples.zh: 你可以坐1号线或者2号线去人民广场。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zuò yī hào xiàn huòzhě èr hào xiàn qù Rénmín Guǎngchǎng.
examples.en: You can take Line 1 or Line 2 to People's Square.

title: Comparing "renjia" and "bieren"
structure: 人家/别人 + Verb
explanation: “人家”和“别人”都可指“别人”，但“人家”还可指“我/他/她”，更口语。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zàihu rénjia zěnme shuō.
examples.en: I don't care about what other people say.

examples.zh: 别人怎么想我怎么知道？
examples.pinyin: Biérén zěnme xiǎng wǒ zěnme zhīdào?
examples.en: How could I know what other people are thinking?

examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi rénjia xǐhuan nǐ a.
examples.en: Because I like you!

examples.pinyin: Nǐ kuài gěi rénjia dàoqiàn.
examples.en: Apologize to them now.

title: Comparing "zhijian" and "zhongjian"
structure: A + 和 + B + 之间/中间；Place (+ 的) + 中间；A + 到 + B + 之间
explanation: “之间”和“中间”都可表示“在……之间”；“中间”还可表示“在……中间/其中”；“之间”还可表示关系、范围。

examples.zh: 上海在江苏省和浙江省之间/中间。
examples.pinyin: Shànghǎi zài Jiāngsū Shěng hé Zhèjiāng Shěng zhījiān/zhōngjiān.
examples.en: Shanghai is between Jiangsu Province and Zhejiang Province.

examples.zh: 客厅的中间有一个沙发。
examples.pinyin: Kètīng de zhōngjiān yǒu yī gè shāfā.
examples.en: There is a sofa in the middle of the living room.

examples.zh: 你们中间有会唱歌的吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhōngjiān yǒu huì chànggē de ma?
examples.en: Can anyone among you sing?

examples.zh: 你可以明天早上八点到十点之间过来。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ míngtiān zǎoshang bā diǎn dào shí diǎn zhījiān guòlái.
examples.en: You can come between 8am and 10am tomorrow.

title: Comparing "li" and "cong"
structure: 从 + Time/Place + 开始/起；离 + Place + 远/近；离 + Future Event + 还有 + Duration
explanation: “从”表示从某地/某时开始移动或变化；“离”表示静态距离或时间距离。

examples.zh: 从下个月起，公司会越来越忙。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xiàge yuè qǐ, gōngsī huì yuèláiyuè máng.
examples.en: Starting from next month, the company will be busier and busier.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiā lí gōngsī duō yuǎn?
examples.en: How far is your home from your company?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí gōngsī hěn jìn.
examples.en: My home is close to my office.

examples.zh: 离我们的婚礼还有两个星期。
examples.pinyin: Lí wǒmen de hūnlǐ háiyǒu liǎng gè xīngqī.
examples.en: We still have two weeks until our wedding.

title: Comparing "yihou" and "de shihou"
structure: Subj. + Verb + 以后/的时候，……
explanation: “以后”表示“之后”；“的时候”表示“当……的时候/在……期间”。

examples.zh: 下飞机以后给我打电话。
examples.pinyin: Xià fēijī yǐhòu gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: Give me a call after you get off the plane.

examples.zh: 吃饭的时候看电视容易长胖。
examples.pinyin: Chīfàn de shíhou kàn diànshì róngyì zhǎng pàng.
examples.en: It's easy to get fat if you eat while you watch TV.

examples.zh: 工作的时候不要上网聊天。
examples.pinyin: Gōngzuò de shíhou bùyào shàngwǎng liáotiān.
examples.en: Don't chat online when you're at work.

examples.zh: 雨停了以后，我们就去公园玩。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ tíng le yǐhòu, wǒmen jiù qù gōngyuán wán.
examples.en: When it stops raining, we'll go play in the park.
